Exhaust temp silinderler arası fark kabu: Difference in exhaust temperature between cylinders acceptable
Exhaust temperature sapması (bir silindi: An exhaust temperature deviation (one cylinder 50°C+ different from the others) is an early warning: it points to an injector fault, a leaking valve or a piston ring problem. Ignoring it invites major damage.
Yardımcı makineler geminin elektrik, hav: Auxiliary machinery supplies the ship's electricity, air and water. Its failure leads to a blackout or the loss of critical systems.
Yardımcı makine bakım programının koordi: Coordination of the auxiliary machinery maintenance programme.
Yardımcı makinelerin bakımını ertelemeyi: Do not postpone auxiliary machinery maintenance. The 'it works, don't touch it' approach is one of the most dangerous attitudes at sea. Keep to the maintenance hours in the PMS; postponed maintenance brings the failure at the worst possible moment.
Balast operasyonu, stabilite ve yapısal: Ballast operations are directly related to stability and structural strength. A faulty ballast operation can lead to the loss of the ship. Biological invasion is also controlled under the BWM Convention.
Overall responsibility for the ballast operation.
Stability calculation and approval of the ballast plan.
Ballast Water Record Book dolduruldu: Ballast Water Record Book filled in
Balast operasyonunu ASLA gözetimsiz bıra: NEVER leave a ballast operation unattended. A tank overflow causes pollution and a deck safety hazard. Always allow for the slack tank (free surface) effect; partly filled tanks seriously reduce stability.
Bunkering sırasında yakıt sızıntısı, çev: Fuel spills during bunkering are one of the most common causes of pollution. Bunkering is subject to strict rules under MARPOL Annex I.
Bunkering operasyonunun genel sorumluluğ: Overall responsibility for the bunkering operation.
Supervision at the manifold and tank monitoring.
MARPOL Ek I – Yakıt sızıntısı önleme: MARPOL Annex I – Prevention of fuel spills
MARPOL Ek VI – Yakıt kalitesi (sülfür li: MARPOL Annex VI – Fuel quality (sulphur limit)
Bunkering sırasında ASLA gözetimsiz bıra: NEVER leave bunkering unattended. Someone must be at the manifold at all times. The thought 'no leak, no problem' is a recipe for disaster. Keep the fuel samples for 12 months – they are your legal evidence in a fuel quality dispute.
Jeneratör arızası blackout'a yol açar. B: A generator failure causes a blackout. A blackout means the loss of propulsion, steering, fire pumps and emergency systems. At sea this can be fatal.
Jeneratör operasyonunun planlanması ve k: Planning and coordination of generator operation.
Senkronizasyon sırasında synchroscope ib: During synchronisation, the synchroscope pointer must turn SLOWLY CLOCKWISE. Closing the breaker while it turns anticlockwise leads to a reverse power trip and damage to the generator. Do not rush; match the frequency gently.
Yakıt transferi sırasında taşma, sızıntı: Overflows, leaks and choosing the wrong tank during fuel transfer are among the most common causes of oil spills. They can result in a MARPOL violation and heavy fines.
SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Yakıt sistemi güvenli: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Safety of fuel systems
Tank kapasiteleri ve mevcut seviyeler ko: Tank capacities and present levels checked
Oil Record Book'a kaydedildi: Entered in the Oil Record Book
Yakıt transferini ASLA yatmadan önce baş: NEVER start a fuel transfer and leave it before going to bed. In an overflow the alarm may not work or may not be heard. A responsible person must be designated to monitor the transfer. Do not forget to close the scuppers.
Yağlama yetersizliği, yatak yanması, pis: Insufficient lubrication leads directly to bearing failure, piston seizure and machinery damage. A drop in LO pressure is one of the most critical alarms and requires immediate action.
Yağlama sistemi yönetimi ve analiz takib: Management of the lubrication system and follow-up of analyses.
Günlük kontroller, filtre temizliği, yağ: Daily checks, filter cleaning, topping up oil.
LO analizinde TBN (Total Base Number) de: In an LO analysis, a TBN (Total Base Number) below 20 shows that the oil's capacity to neutralise acids has decreased. This is critical with high-sulphur fuels; a low TBN leads to liner corrosion.
Yetersiz soğutma, aşırı ısınma, termal s: Insufficient cooling leads to overheating, thermal stress and machinery damage. If cooling water leaks into a cylinder, a hydraulic lock forms and the connecting rod may break.
Jacket water sıcaklığının ani yükselmesi: A sudden rise in jacket water temperature may indicate a thermostat fault, pump cavitation or an air lock. A falling expansion tank level indicates a leak; if the leak is into a cylinder, the consequences are disastrous.
Sintine yönetimi MARPOL Ek I'in en sıkı: Bilge management is the most strictly inspected subject of MARPOL Annex I. An OWS bypass or discharge of dirty bilge water can result in severe criminal penalties and imprisonment.
Sintine seviye takibi ve pompa operasyon: Monitoring bilge levels and operating the pumps.
MARPOL Ek I, Kural 14 – Yağlı su deşarjı: MARPOL Annex I, Regulations 14–15 – Oil filtering equipment and control of discharge of oil (15 ppm)
Oil Record Book Part I güncel: Oil Record Book Part I up to date
OWS'yi ASLA bypass etmeyin. 'Magic pipe': NEVER bypass the OWS. The use of a 'magic pipe' has resulted in some of the heaviest penalties in maritime history. If detected in US ports, it leads to fines of millions of dollars and prison sentences. If the 15 ppm alarm is not working properly, do not use the system; discharge to a port reception facility.
Temizlenmemiş yakıt, enjektör tıkanması,: Uncleaned fuel leads to injector blockage, excessive wear and machinery damage. When cat fines (Al+Si) exceed 15 ppm, damage to liners and piston rings is unavoidable.
LO separator operasyonu ve sludge tank t: LO separator operation and sludge tank monitoring.
Separator'ü tam kapasitede çalıştırmayın: Do not run the separator at full capacity; running at 50–70% capacity improves separation efficiency dramatically. If there is a cat fines problem, connect two separators in series (purifier + clarifier). If the wrong gravity disc is selected, the oil–water interface shifts and no separation takes place.
Kazan patlaması denizcilik tarihinin en: Boiler explosions are among the deadliest accidents in maritime history. A low water level or a safety valve failure has disastrous consequences.
Kazan operasyonunun planlanması ve bakım: Planning of boiler operation and coordination of maintenance.
Daily operation, water testing and blowdown.
Su seviyesi gauge glass ile kontrol edil: Water level checked with the gauge glass
Kazan su seviyesini ASLA gauge glass olm: NEVER monitor the boiler water level without the gauge glass. Electronic level indicators can fail. A spare glass must be ready in case the gauge glass bursts. It is vital not to skip the pre-purge; an accumulation of unburnt fuel leads to a furnace explosion.
Başlatma havası olmadan ana makine çalış: The main engine cannot be started without starting air. Lack of starting capacity in an emergency directly threatens the safety of the ship. Class rules, rather than SOLAS, require a capacity of at least 12 consecutive starts (reversible engines).
SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Başlatma havası gerek: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Starting air requirements
Hava şişelerini drenaj etmeyi ihmal etme: Do not neglect draining the air receivers. Accumulated moisture enters the cylinders through the starting air line and causes corrosion and damage to the starting valves. Drain daily and always keep at least two air receivers full.
Pompalar geminin damar sistemidir. Yakıt: Pumps are the ship's circulatory system. The fuel, cooling, lubrication, ballast, bilge, fire and cargo systems all depend on pumps.
Planning of the pump maintenance programme.
PMS bakım kayıtları güncel: PMS maintenance records up to date
Santrifüj pompayı kuru çalıştırmak, mech: Running a centrifugal pump dry burns out the mechanical seal within seconds. Before starting the pump, make sure the suction valve is open and the pump has been vented. If you hear cavitation noise (like gravel), stop it immediately.
Elektrik arızası blackout'a yol açar. Bl: An electrical failure leads to a blackout. A blackout at sea means the loss of steering, radar, ECDIS and fire pumps.
Elektrik sistemi bakım ve arıza gidermes: Maintenance and fault finding of the electrical system.
Responsibility for managing the electrical system.
Switchboard üzerinde çalışırken ASLA tek: NEVER work on a switchboard alone. Someone must be watching and must know where the emergency stop is. The risk of arc flash is life-threatening. Wear suitable PPE (arc flash suit, insulated gloves).
Modern gemilerin büyük çoğunluğu UMS (Un: Most modern ships are of the UMS (Unattended Machinery Space) class. An automation failure makes it necessary to keep the engine room under continuous watch and increases the workload of the crew.
Overall responsibility for the automation system.
Maintenance of sensors, PLCs and control systems.
Alarm yorgunluğu (alarm fatigue) ciddi b: Alarm fatigue is a serious risk. Constantly sounding nuisance alarms cause a real critical alarm to be missed. Fix the root cause instead of suppressing unnecessary alarms. An 'accepted alarm' policy should be written under the ISM system.
Denizde yedek parça bulunamaz. Kritik bi: Spare parts cannot be found at sea. The lack of a critical spare part means a machinery failure that cannot be resolved, and off-hire.
Spare parts budget and overall management.
Envanter takibi ve sipariş koordinasyonu: Inventory control and coordination of orders.
IMPA katalog numaralarını doğru kullanın: Use the IMPA catalogue numbers correctly. A wrong part number means the wrong part arrives and weeks of waiting. Keep at least one extra set of critical spare parts (injectors, piston rings, gasket sets).
Engine Log Book, makine performansının t: The Engine Log Book is the history of machinery performance. It is a critical document in PSC inspections, failure analysis and legal disputes.
Engine Log Book'un doğruluğu ve kontrolü: Accuracy and checking of the Engine Log Book.
Keeps the records during the watch.
C/E kontrolü ve imzası: Checked and signed by the C/E
Engine Log Book'taki exhaust temperature: Monitor the exhaust temperature data in the Engine Log Book as a trend. A gradual rise in one cylinder's temperature over weeks lets you detect injector wear or an exhaust valve leak early.
PMS, ISM Code Bölüm 10 gereği zorunludur: A PMS is mandatory under ISM Code Section 10. PMS records are examined in detail in PSC inspections. Missing or falsified records are a reason for deficiencies and detention.
Kendi sorumluluk alanlarındaki bakım işl: Carry out the maintenance in their own areas of responsibility and keep records.
Bakım programı güncel ve takip ediliyor: Maintenance programme up to date and being followed
PMS kayıtlarını 'yapmış gibi' doldurmak: Filling in PMS records 'as if done' is the most dangerous habit. PSC inspectors can verify by physical inspection whether maintenance recorded as 'done' in the PMS was really done. Falsified records are an ISM major non-conformity.
LO analizi erken arıza teşhisi sağlar (m: LO analysis allows early fault diagnosis (metal particles show bearing wear, water contamination shows a leak). FO analysis verifies that the fuel quality complies with MARPOL and ISO 8217.
Analiz programı ve sonuç değerlendirmesi: Analysis programme and evaluation of results.
MARPOL Ek VI – Yakıt sülfür limiti: MARPOL Annex VI – Fuel sulphur limit
LO numuneleri planlanan aralıkta alındı: LO samples taken at the planned intervals
FO numunesi her bunkering'de alındı: FO sample taken at every bunkering
Limit aşımı varsa aksiyon alındı: Action taken if a limit was exceeded
LO analizinde demir (Fe) partikül miktar: A sudden increase in iron (Fe) particles in an LO analysis is an early warning of bearing or liner wear. A rising trend shows that serious damage may occur soon. Monitor analysis results as a TREND; look at the trend, not at a single result.
Kirli makine dairesi yangın riskini artı: A dirty engine room increases the fire risk (oil deposits + hot surfaces = fire), makes leaks harder to detect and leaves a bad impression in PSC inspections.
Temiz makine dairesi = güvenli makine da: A clean engine room = a safe engine room. When a PSC inspector enters the engine room, the first impression is very important. A dirty, untidy engine room gives the impression that maintenance is poor too and triggers a detailed inspection. In addition, oil-soaked lagging on a hot exhaust manifold can catch fire.
Blackout durumunda acil aydınlatma, seyi: In a blackout, the emergency generator, which supplies the emergency lighting, navigation lights, GMDSS, steering gear and fire pumps, is vital equipment. Under SOLAS it must come on line automatically within 45 seconds.
Emergency generator bakım ve test soruml: Responsibility for maintaining and testing the emergency generator.
SOLAS Bölüm II-1, Kural 44 – Acil güç ka: SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 43 – Emergency source of electrical power in cargo ships
Emergency generator testini GERÇEKTEN ya: REALLY test the emergency generator. A 'start and stop' is not enough in the weekly test; run it for at least 10 minutes and monitor the parameters. In the 6-monthly test, transfer real load to the emergency switchboard. Testing it only at no load does not prevent it from failing under load.
Dümen arızası, geminin manevra kabiliyet: A steering failure means the ship loses her manoeuvrability. SOLAS requires a steering test before every voyage, and it is checked in PSC inspections.
Responsibility for maintaining and testing the steering gear.
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 26 – Dümen testi ge: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 26 – Steering gear testing requirements
SOLAS Bölüm II-1, Kural 29 – Steering ge: SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 29 – Steering gear requirements
Steering gear odasını düzenli ziyaret ed: Visit the steering gear room regularly. A hydraulic oil leak can be seen before the pressure drops. If a small leak is repaired before it grows, loss of steering at sea is prevented. ALL officers must know the way to the steering gear room.
Makine dairesi, geminin en tehlikeli çal: The engine room is the most dangerous working area on the ship: high temperatures, pressurised systems, rotating parts, noise, chemicals and enclosed-space risks all come together.
Makine dairesi güvenliğinin genel soruml: Overall responsibility for engine room safety.
PTW düzenlendi (gerekli işler için): PTW issued (for jobs that require it)
İlk yardım malzemesi makine dairesinde m: First aid supplies available in the engine room
Lock-out/Tag-out hayat kurtarır. Bakım s: Lock-out/tag-out saves lives. The thought during maintenance that 'it will be done in a minute, no need to lock it' is the most common way hands and fingers are lost. Isolate the machinery, lock it and keep your own key in your pocket. DO NOT allow anyone else to remove the lock on your behalf.
Uluslararası deniz taşımacılığında can e: Sets the basic requirements for the safety of life in international shipping; covers standards for ship construction, equipment, operation and certification. First adopted in 1914 after the Titanic disaster, SOLAS is the most important convention in maritime history and is continually updated.
Gemilerden kaynaklanan deniz kirliliğini: Sets international standards for the prevention of marine pollution from ships; its six annexes regulate oil, noxious liquid substances, harmful substances in packaged form, sewage, garbage and air emissions. MARPOL 73/78 is the cornerstone of marine environmental protection.
MARPOL'ün kökeni 1954 OILPOL sözleşmesin: MARPOL has its origins in the 1954 OILPOL Convention. After the 1967 Torrey Canyon accident, IMO began preparing a comprehensive pollution prevention convention; the convention adopted in 1973 was combined with the 1978 Protocol and became known as MARPOL 73/78. Annex VI (air pollution) was added by the 1997 Protocol. Today its 6 annexes cover all types of pollution from ships.
Tüm uluslararası sefer yapan gemiler (bo: All ships on international voyages (subject to the relevant annexes regardless of size and type)
Ek I: 150 GT üzeri tankerler ve 400 GT ü: Annex I: oil tankers of 150 GT and above and other ships of 400 GT and above
Ek II: Zararlı sıvı madde taşıyan tüm ge: Annex II: all ships carrying noxious liquid substances
Ek III: Ambalajlı zararlı madde taşıyan: Annex III: ships carrying harmful substances in packaged form
Ek IV: 400 GT üzeri gemiler veya 15'ten: Annex IV: ships of 400 GT and above, or ships certified to carry more than 15 persons
Ek VI: 400 GT üzeri gemiler (EEXI/CII: 5: Annex VI: ships of 400 GT and above (CII: 5,000 GT and above)
Ek I: Petrol kirliliği – IOPP sertifikas: Annex I: oil pollution – IOPP Certificate, ORB, OWS (15 ppm), SOPEP, double-hull requirement for tankers
Ek II: Zararlı sıvı maddeler (NLS) – kat: Annex II: noxious liquid substances (NLS) – categorisation (X, Y, Z, OS), P&A Manual, Cargo Record Book
Ek III: Ambalajlı zararlı maddeler – IMD: Annex III: harmful substances in packaged form – marking and documentation with reference to the IMDG Code
Ek IV: Kanalizasyon – sewage treatment p: Annex IV: sewage – sewage treatment plant, discharge criteria (12 miles from land, 4 knots speed)
Ek V: Çöp yönetimi – Garbage Record Book: Annex V: garbage management – Garbage Record Book, Garbage Management Plan, discharge prohibitions and exceptions
Ek VI: Hava kirliliği – SOx limiti (%0.5: Annex VI: air pollution – SOx limit (0.50% global, 0.10% ECA), NOx Tier I-II-III, EEXI, CII, SEEMP
Özel Alanlar (Special Areas): Akdeniz, B: Special Areas: stricter rules for the Mediterranean, Baltic, Black Sea, Red Sea and Gulfs areas
ORB Part I ve II, Cargo Record Book ve G: Keep complete ORB Part I and II, Cargo Record Book and Garbage Record Book entries
IOPP ve IAPP sertifikalarını güncel tut: Keep the IOPP and IAPP certificates up to date
Yakıt numuneleri ve BDN'leri minimum 3 y: Keep BDNs for at least 3 years and fuel samples for at least 12 months
SEEMP'i uygula ve CII performansını aylı: Implement the SEEMP and monitor CII performance monthly
OWS, bilge alarm, ODM ve EGCS sistemleri: Test the OWS, bilge alarm, ODM and EGCS systems periodically
Özel alan (Special Area) kurallarını rot: Integrate the Special Area rules into passage planning

An ECA under Annex VI sets separate emission limits for SOx/particulate matter and/or NOx.
Bir deşarj kararı en az altı soruyu yanı: A discharge decision answers at least six questions: which annex/category the substance falls under, what status the ship and equipment have, whether the ship is en route, what the position/nearest land and special area status are, whether the treatment/comminution/monitoring requirements are met, and whether there is a stricter flag/port/company prohibition. A single distance figure does not replace this tree.
Chart plotter veya GPS konumu kararın gi: The chart plotter or GPS position is an input to the decision; the special area boundary, the baseline/nearest land definition and any local no-discharge zone are verified separately. A certified device is not sufficient without a correct oil content meter, flow input and overboard valve action.

A wrong tank sequence or an inadequate inert atmosphere combines the pollution risk with a fire/explosion risk.

SOPEP içindeki eski telefon listesini ge: Treating the old telephone list in the SOPEP as valid
Machinery-space ve tanker kayıt rejimler: The machinery-space and tanker record regimes are separate.
15 ppm/ODME cihazı boru hattı ve kayıtla: The 15 ppm/ODME device is verified together with the piping and the records.
İlk kirlilik bildirimi erken yapılır, ve: The initial pollution report is made early and the data are updated later.
Annex II: dökme zararlı sıvı maddeler: Annex II: noxious liquid substances in bulk
Annex II, ürünün deniz çevresine tehlike: Annex II links the hazard of a product to the marine environment with the ship's tank/stripping capability and the port reception arrangements; no discharge decision can be made until the product name has been correctly established.
X, Y, Z ve Other Substances kategorileri: Categories X, Y, Z and Other Substances
Noxious Liquid Substances; Category X, Y: Noxious Liquid Substances are classified as Category X, Y, Z or Other Substances. X requires the strictest control because of the most serious hazard to marine resources/human health, while Y and Z represent decreasing but real hazard levels. Although OS fall outside these categories for Annex II purposes, they are not exempt from other MARPOL, SOLAS or local obligations.
Doğru product name ve pollution category: The correct product name and pollution category are verified through the IBC Code product list, the MEPC circular/list and the Certificate of Fitness. A trade name or SDS alone is not the authoritative carriage name. If the composition of a mixture changes, the category and carriage requirements are reassessed.
Prewash, stripping, ventilation veya rec: Whether prewash, stripping, ventilation or a reception facility is mandatory depends, besides the category, on high-viscosity/solidifying properties, the unloading port, special area and the approved procedure. A general 'pump it out beyond 12 miles' approach wrongly simplifies the Annex II decision tree.
Cargo plan her ürün için pollution categ: The cargo plan should include, for each product, columns for pollution category, tank, stripping limit, prewash/reception and discharge method.
Trade name ile kategori seçmek: Choosing the category by trade name
OS ürününü hiçbir çevre kuralına tabi de: Thinking an OS product is not subject to any environmental rule
Onaylı Procedures and Arrangements Manua: The approved Procedures and Arrangements Manual defines the unloading, stripping, tank washing, residue transfer and discharge method according to the ship's tank/piping geometry. Rather than a general Annex II summary, this ship-specific manual is the governing document for the valve line-up and sequence on site.
Efficient stripping, tankta kalan residu: Efficient stripping aims to reduce the residue remaining in the tank to the approved performance limit. The stripping result can be affected by pump/line condition, trim/list, temperature/viscosity and correct terminal back-pressure. Even if the sequence has been completed on paper, if there is high residue or line content, the prewash/reception decision changes.
Cargo Record Book; loading, internal tra: The Cargo Record Book records operations such as loading, internal transfer, unloading, prewash, tank cleaning, residue discharge and accidental discharge by tank and product. It must reconcile with the terminal prewash receipt, cargo figures, tank washing log and slop/reception quantity.
Baş zabit operasyon öncesi P&A Manual'da: Before the operation, the Chief Officer should go through the actual tank/line sequence in the P&A Manual with the team and the terminal in a toolbox briefing.
Önceki ürünün checklist'ini yeni ürüne k: Copying the checklist of the previous product to the new product
Stripping performansını yalnız pompa çal: Proving stripping performance only with a 'pump running' entry
Tahliye sonrası tankta beklenenden fazla: After discharge, more product than expected remains in the tank; the terminal does not want to accept a prewash and suggests the ship washes at sea.
Kategori, ürün özelliği, liman/reception: A decision to discharge at sea cannot be made until the category, product properties, port/reception and P&A Manual conditions are complete. A commercial refusal does not remove a legal obligation.
Operasyon durdurulur; bayrak/liman/şirke: The operation is stopped; a suitable reception/prewash solution is set up and documented with the flag/port/company and the terminal. The tank/line quantity and all communications are preserved in the Cargo Record Book supporting records.
Ürün adı ve pollution category kararın b: The product name and pollution category are the starting point of the decision.
P&A Manual gemiye özgü operasyon sırasın: The P&A Manual sets the ship-specific operational sequence.
Terminal kısıtı Annex II zorunluluğunu o: A terminal restriction does not remove an Annex II obligation.
Annex III: paketli zararlı maddeler ve I: Annex III: harmful substances in packaged form and the IMDG link
Annex III deniz kirletici maddeleri pack: Annex III controls marine pollutants in packaged forms of carriage such as packages, freight containers, portable tanks or road/rail tank wagons, through the detailed system of the IMDG Code.
Marine pollutant sınıflandırması, paketl: Marine pollutant classification, packaging and documentation
Bir maddenin harmful substance sayılması: Whether a substance is a harmful substance is determined by the marine pollutant criteria and lists in the IMDG Code. The UN number, proper shipping name, class/subsidiary risk, packing group and marine pollutant status are declared together. The SDS is a useful supporting document; it does not replace the signed dangerous goods transport document.
Package tipi, test/UN approval mark, qua: The package type, test/UN approval mark, quantity limit, closure and condition must suit the product. The marine pollutant mark, class label, UN number and cargo transport unit placards communicate the hazard correctly from the outside. A faded mark or one placed on the wrong surface makes the information invisible to the emergency team.
Dokümanda paket sayısı/tipi, toplam mikt: The document contains the number/type of packages, the total quantity and the correct shipping description; the shipper's declaration and the container/vehicle packing certificate document responsibility in the process. The manifest/stowage plan shows the location of dangerous goods on board in a way that is accessible in an emergency.
Yük kabulünde belge, dış paket işareti v: When accepting cargo, the document, the outer package marking and the planned stowage position should be checked on the same sample.
Marine pollutant mark'ı primary hazard l: Taking the marine pollutant mark for the primary hazard label
SDS ile eksik shipper declaration'ı kapa: Making up for a missing shipper's declaration with the SDS
Stowage, segregation, kayıp/hasar ve aci: Stowage, segregation, loss/damage and emergency response
IMDG stowage category, segregation group: IMDG stowage categories, segregation groups and provisions such as 'away from'/'separated from' limit the escalation of reactions, fire and toxic exposure. Relationships with foodstuffs, accommodation, heat sources and ignition sources are also checked. Even if the container planning software gives no warning, the current IMDG edition and the scope of the ship's Document of Compliance are verified.
Hasarlı/leaking package'da ilk hedef per: With a damaged/leaking package, the first aim is the safety of personnel and the ship. The area is isolated according to the EmS, MFAG, SDS and the company emergency plan, suitable PPE/monitoring is used and spreading overboard is prevented. Repacking or jettisoning is considered only with authority and under conditions of necessity; the incident and lost packages are reported through the appropriate channels.
Dangerous goods manifest, köprüüstü ve a: The dangerous goods manifest should be kept ready in a controlled arrangement that the bridge and emergency teams can reach before abandoning the ship.
Yazılımın kabulünü hukukî uygunluk onayı: Treating acceptance by the software as confirmation of legal compliance
Dökülen ürünü yıkayarak scupper'a yönlen: Washing spilled product towards the scuppers
Marine pollutant konteynerinde sızıntı: Leak from a marine pollutant container
Güverte turunda konteyner kapısından sıv: During a deck round, liquid is seen coming from a container door; the manifest lists the product as class 8 and a marine pollutant.
Yaklaşma, bilinmeyen buhar/reaksiyon ve: Approaching carries the risk of unknown vapour/reaction and spreading into the sea. Washing with water can escalate the environmental incident.
Alarm/alan izolasyonu, EmS/MFAG ve uzman: Alarm/area isolation is carried out and PPE/monitoring are selected with the EmS/MFAG and expert support; the scuppers are protected, the leak is safely contained and notifications to the Master/company/shore are started.
Annex III ayrıntılarını IMDG Code operas: The IMDG Code puts the details of Annex III into operation.
Belge, paket ve stow position aynı yükü: The document, the package and the stowage position must show the same cargo.
Sızıntıda personel güvenliği ile denize: In a leak, personnel safety and spreading into the sea are controlled together.
Annex IV: pis su sistemleri ve kontrollü: Annex IV: sewage systems and controlled discharge
Annex IV, sewage'ı onaylı arıtma tesisi,: Annex IV manages sewage with the options of an approved treatment plant, a comminuting/disinfecting system or a holding tank; the choice of system changes the discharge conditions and the record-keeping/operation on board.
Sewage tanımı, sertifika ve sistem bütün: Definition of sewage, certificate and system integrity
Sewage; toilet/urinal drenajı, medical p: Sewage covers drainage from toilets/urinals, medical premises and spaces containing living animals, and other waste waters mixed with these. Galley grey water alone may not be Annex IV sewage; however, when mixed with sewage it falls under the same regime, and local rules can impose separate, stricter limits on grey water.
ISPP Certificate, onaylı sewage treatmen: The ISPP Certificate shows the approved sewage treatment plant, comminuter/disinfector or holding tank arrangement. Treatment plant performance depends on correct aeration, biomass/chemical condition, blowers/pumps, alarms and the maker's operating envelope. A bypass valve, an overflow line or wrong chemical dosing makes the certified system ineffective.
Holding tank kapasitesi kişi sayısı, sef: Holding tank capacity is planned with the number of persons, voyage duration and actual generation. A reception facility or a legal discharge opportunity must be found before the tank is full. Silencing the high-level alarm does not replace an operational plan.
Başmühendis sewage flow'u, tank seviyesi: The Chief Engineer should monitor the sewage flow, tank level and plant condition against the voyage plan, and the Master the discharge position/permission conditions.
Grey water ve sewage hatlarını çizimden: Not verifying the grey water and sewage lines from the drawing
Treatment plant blower çalışıyorsa efflu: Assuming the effluent is acceptable because the treatment plant blower is running
Deşarj seçenekleri: arıtılmış, parçalanm: Discharge options: treated, comminuted/disinfected and untreated sewage
Onaylı sewage treatment plant uygun şeki: While an approved sewage treatment plant is operating properly, discharge is made in accordance with the plant's performance standard and the Annex IV conditions; it must not produce visible floating solids or discolouration of the surrounding water. If the treatment system is bypassed, this option cannot be used.
Comminuted ve disinfected sewage, onaylı: Comminuted and disinfected sewage may be discharged using an approved system at more than 3 nautical miles from the nearest land; sewage that is not comminuted/disinfected may generally be discharged at more than 12 nautical miles, while the ship is en route and at a suitable rate of discharge approved by the Administration. Pumping out the tank contents all at once or discharging while the ship is stopped does not meet the condition.
Passenger ships için belirli special are: For passenger ships, certain special area provisions and local no-discharge/reception rules may also apply. At the time of the discharge decision, the ship type, treatment status, position, speed/en route status, source tank and port instructions must be recorded together.
Sewage discharge checklist, plant valve: The sewage discharge checklist should turn the plant valve line-up and alarm status into a two-department permit with bridge confirmation of position/speed.
3/12 mil sayılarını tek koşul olarak ezb: Memorising the 3/12 mile figures as the only condition
Treatment plant arızasını loglamadan byp: Bypassing without logging a treatment plant failure
Liman çıkışından kısa süre sonra holding: Shortly after leaving port, the holding tank reaches the high-high alarm; the ship is not yet beyond 12 nautical miles.
Taşma riski ciddi olsa da bu durum planl: Although the risk of overflow is serious, this does not automatically justify an unplanned illegal discharge. The cause of the fault and the safe options are assessed quickly.
Üretim azaltılır, treatment/reception/tr: Generation is reduced and treatment/reception/transfer options and a safe solution on the route are investigated; the Master/company and, if necessary, the coastal authority are informed. If an emergency discharge really becomes necessary for the safety of life/the ship, the exception conditions and all evidence for the decision are recorded in detail.
Sewage'ın kaynağı ve karışımı doğru tanı: The source and mixture of the sewage are correctly identified.
Sistem sertifikası gerçek işletme kondis: The system certificate is supported by the actual operating condition.
Mesafe, en-route ve arıtma şartları birl: The distance, en route and treatment conditions are applied together.
Annex V: çöp kategorileri, yasaklar ve k: Annex V: garbage categories, prohibitions and record integrity
Annex V'nin varsayılan yaklaşımı çöpün d: The default approach of Annex V is that garbage is segregated and reduced on board, not at sea, and delivered to a shore reception facility; the limited discharge exceptions depend on the category and conditions.
Garbage tanımı, kategoriler ve plastik y: Definition of garbage, categories and the plastics prohibition
Garbage; domestic waste, operational was: Garbage covers categories such as domestic waste, operational waste, food waste, plastics, cargo residues, incinerator ashes, cooking oil, fishing gear and animal carcasses. Not every category has the same discharge options. Hazardous substances in e-waste or maintenance waste can also trigger other national/international waste rules.
Plastiklerin, synthetic ropes/nets, plas: The discharge into the sea of plastics, including synthetic ropes/nets, plastic garbage bags and incinerator ash containing plastic, is prohibited. A 'biodegradable' label does not automatically mean that the product is not a plastic under Annex V or that it can be discharged into the sea; the composition and the authoritative guidance are verified.
Food waste, cargo residue, cleaning agen: The distance, comminution, special area, HME status and en route conditions differ for food waste, cargo residues, cleaning agents/additives and animal carcasses. Mixed garbage is subject to the requirements of whichever component is stricter. Grinding garbage does not change its category or the plastics prohibition.
Çöp istasyonunda kategori renkleri GMP/G: At the garbage station, the category colours must be the same as the GMP/GRB codes; when mixed waste arises, the stricter category must be clearly applied.
Biodegradable plastiği denize atılabilir: Thinking biodegradable plastic can be discharged into the sea
Comminuter kullanınca bütün food packagi: Counting all food packaging as food waste because a comminuter is used
Garbage Management Plan toplama, separat: The Garbage Management Plan describes the collection, separation, processing, storage, discharge and reception process, the persons responsible and the equipment on board. Placards show crew and passengers the applicable prohibitions in an understandable language. The plan must match the ship's actual compactor, grinder, incinerator and storage arrangements.
Garbage Record Book; denize deşarj, rece: The Garbage Record Book records events such as discharge into the sea, delivery to a reception facility, incineration, accidental loss/discharge and loss of fishing gear with category, quantity, time and position. The volume estimation method must be consistent and reasonably balanced with receipts, the storage inventory and the incinerator log.
Port reception facility yetersizse bu du: An inadequate port reception facility does not give permission for random discharge at sea. The inadequacy is taken through the Master/company to the appropriate IMO/port reporting mechanism; the ship's storage capacity and the plan for the next suitable port are updated. The licence and delivery chain of the waste contractor are verified according to local rules.
Baş zabit/çevre zabiti weekly garbage ba: The Chief Officer/environmental officer should monitor generation, storage, incineration and receipt quantities by category with a weekly garbage balance.
Teslim fişindeki toplam miktarı kategori: Entering the total quantity on the delivery receipt into the GRB without separating the categories
Reception facility reddini kaydetmeden a: Storing waste unsafely on deck without recording the reception facility's refusal
Tahliye sonrası hold wash water planlanı: After discharge, hold wash water is planned; the shipper cannot document that the cargo residue is not harmful to the marine environment.
HME status bilinmeden Annex V deşarj ist: An Annex V discharge exception cannot be assumed while the HME status is unknown. The cleaning agent and special area status must also be determined separately.
Denize deşarj yapılmaz; shipper declarat: No discharge into the sea is made; the shipper's declaration and the product criteria are verified. If compliance cannot be proven, the residue/wash water is kept on board or delivered to a reception facility and recorded in the GRB under the correct category.
Karışık çöp daha sıkı bileşenin rejimine: Mixed garbage falls under the regime of the stricter component.
Plastik yasağı öğütme veya biodegradable: The plastics prohibition is not lifted by grinding or a biodegradable claim.
GRB miktarı fiziksel depolama ve receipt: The GRB quantity reconciles with the physical storage and receipts.
Annex VI: hava kirliliği, yakıt uygunluğ: Annex VI: air pollution, fuel compliance and energy efficiency
Annex VI, baca emisyonlarından ozon taba: Annex VI brings together technical and operational controls ranging from funnel emissions to ozone-depleting substances, and from the fuel quality chain to the ship's carbon intensity.
SOx/PM, fuel oil quality, BDN ve numune: SOx/PM, fuel oil quality, the BDN and the sample chain
SOx ve particulate matter kontrolü yakıt: SOx and particulate matter are controlled through the sulphur content of the fuel or an approved equivalent arrangement. The global limit and the ECA limit differ; according to its position, the tank used and the system volume, the ship must complete the change-over before the ECA boundary. If an exhaust gas cleaning system is used, the approval, monitoring, washwater/residue and malfunction procedures apply.
Bunker Delivery Note teslim edilen yakıt: The Bunker Delivery Note carries the mandatory information on the fuel delivered and the supplier's declaration; the representative MARPOL delivered sample is protected with a chain of seal, label, signature and retention. Onboard samples and in-use samples serve different verification purposes. The sample seal number must match the BDN and the ship's records.
Off-spec şüphesi yalnız laboratuvar yüzd: Suspected off-spec fuel is not just a laboratory percentage. Tank segregation, supplier notification, the flag/port report, Fuel Oil Non-Availability Report conditions and safe fuel management are assessed. A FONAR does not provide an automatic exemption; it documents the reasonable efforts the ship made to obtain compliant fuel.
Bunker checklist, BDN/sample seal/tank t: The bunker checklist should link the BDN/sample seal/tank allocation and the ECA change-over calculation in a single traceable file.
BDN uygun olduğu için kullanılan tankı d: Not verifying the tank in use because the BDN is compliant
FONAR'ı düşük sülfür sınırından genel mu: Thinking a FONAR is a general exemption from the low sulphur limit
ECA sınırında change-over gecikmesi: Delayed change-over at the ECA boundary
Beklenenden güçlü akıntı gemiyi ECA sını: A stronger than expected current brings the ship to the ECA boundary early; there is still high-sulphur fuel in the system.
Valfi sınırda çevirmek, service system i: Turning the valve at the boundary does not mean the contents of the service system are compliant in time. The planning calculation should have been updated with the actual speed/flow.
Emniyetli navigasyon korunarak change-ov: While maintaining safe navigation, the change-over is completed in the shortest safe time and the Master/company and the required authorities are informed; the time/position/tank/quantity and reason are recorded transparently and the planning procedure is corrected.
Marine diesel engine NOx uygunluğu; engi: NOx compliance of a marine diesel engine depends on the engine's construction/major conversion status, rated power/speed, the applicable Tier, the EIAPP Certificate and the approved Technical File. If the parameter check method is used, component/setting/seal records are kept; an unauthorised turbocharger, injector or timing change can invalidate certificate compliance.
Ozone-depleting substances içeren sistem: For systems containing ozone-depleting substances, the prohibition on deliberate emissions, the equipment/ODS Record Book, recharging/servicing and the shore disposal chain are managed. Prohibitions on new installations and exceptions are verified according to the substance/equipment date. A refrigerant leak is not only a maintenance issue but a MARPOL record and emission event.
VOC tanker gereklilikleri port designati: VOC requirements for tankers are managed with the port designation and the approved VOC Management Plan; shipboard incineration with the approved incinerator, prohibited substances, operating temperature and records. Improper burning of waste such as PVC or certain chemical/contaminated packaging can create toxic emissions and ash management problems.
Başmühendis, critical engine components: When accepting spare parts, the Chief Engineer should compare the critical engine components with the list of allowable components/settings in the Technical File.
EIAPP varsa her motor modifikasyonunu uy: Considering every engine modification acceptable because there is an EIAPP
Refrigerant eklemeyi leak repair olmadan: Treating refrigerant top-up as normal consumption without a leak repair
EEDI/EEXI, CII, SEEMP ve IMO DCS veri bü: EEDI/EEXI, CII, SEEMP and IMO DCS data integrity
EEDI yeni gemi tasarım verimliliğini, EE: EEDI measures the design efficiency of a new ship, EEXI the technical efficiency level of an existing ship and CII the annual operational carbon intensity; they are different instruments. Attained/required values and ship applicability are verified separately. EEXI compliance may include an approved technical arrangement such as engine power limitation; an override is used only under a defined safety condition and with a record.
SEEMP Part I operasyonel iyileştirme pla: SEEMP Part I contains the operational improvement plan, Part II the fuel oil consumption data collection methodology and Part III the CII implementation plan and the required corrective action approach. The CII rating A-E shows annual performance; a poor rating is managed through its root causes, such as routing, waiting, hull/propeller, weather routing, trim and commercial planning, rather than a one-off speed reduction.
IMO DCS/CII verisi noon report, bunker d: IMO DCS/CII data are made up of noon reports, bunker deliveries, tank soundings, flowmeters, distance/time and cargo capacity inputs. Manual corrections, sensor gaps, off-hire or voyage boundary rules must be handled with a documented methodology. A verified report does not mean that an unexplained change in the raw data is automatically correct.
Gemi ve kıyı ekibi aylık fuel-distance-h: The ship and shore teams should carry out a monthly fuel-distance-hours reconciliation; a difference found at the end of the year should not be closed with a retrospective estimate.
EEXI ile CII'yi aynı performans gösterge: Thinking EEXI and CII are the same performance indicator
CII için emniyetli sefer planı veya maki: Applying pressure for CII that would breach a safe voyage plan or machinery limits
Yakıt uygunluğu belgeden tanka ve bacaya: Fuel compliance is traced from the document to the tank and the funnel.
NOx uygunluğu engine konfigürasyonunun T: NOx compliance is the faithfulness of the engine configuration to the Technical File.
Enerji verisi ham kaynaktan doğrulanmış: Energy data must be auditable from the raw source to the verified report.
Kirlilik olayı, istisnalar, bildirim ve: Pollution incidents, exceptions, reporting and cross-annex evidence management
MARPOL'un amacı kural dışı deşarjı kayıt: The aim of MARPOL is not to erase an illegal discharge from the records, but to prevent it, limit the damage when it happens, report early and learn from the incident at system level.
İstisnalar dar yorumlanır: gemi/can emni: Exceptions are interpreted narrowly: safety of the ship/life and damage cases
Annexlerde can veya gemi emniyeti için z: The annexes can contain certain exceptions for a discharge necessary for the safety of life or the ship and for pollution after damage to the ship/equipment. These do not cover a normal capacity planning error or lack of maintenance. For the damage exception, conditions such as all reasonable precautions having been taken to prevent/minimise the damage and the absence of intentional or reckless conduct by the owner/master are important.
Acil durumda önce hayat ve gemi emniyeti: In an emergency, the safety of life and the ship is protected first, but the environmental impact remains part of the decision. A contemporaneous log shows why there was no other option, what quantity was released when and where, which mitigating measures were applied and who was informed.
Bir sistemin tank kapasitesi düzenli ola: If a system's tank capacity is regularly insufficient, this is not an unexpected emergency but a failure of voyage/capacity management. The company should correct the root cause through the reception facility plan, the waste generation rate and equipment reliability.
Acil deşarj karar formu, karar yetkisi v: The emergency discharge decision form should speed up the decision authority and reporting; it should not be used to produce a legal justification afterwards.
Her arızayı otomatik force majeure sayma: Treating every failure automatically as force majeure
Olay küçük diye kıyı bildirimini tamamen: Skipping the shore report entirely because the incident is small
Protocol I raporu ve ilk saatlerde kanıt: The Protocol I report and preserving evidence in the first hours
MARPOL Protocol I, harmful substances iç: MARPOL Protocol I supports the reporting, without delay and through the appropriate channels, of incidents involving harmful substances to the nearest coastal State. The initial report can clearly mark uncertain data as an 'estimate'; what matters is the early warning and follow-up reports as the data are confirmed.
Olay yeri emniyetli hale getirildikten s: After the scene has been made safe, the logbook, record books, alarm/event log, valve positions, tank soundings, samples, CCTV/VDR and communication records are preserved. Personnel are asked to give separate factual statements; creating a shared story or altering past records destroys credibility.
Şirket emergency response, P&I/charter v: Company emergency response, P&I/charter and legal communications support the operational response; the Master must not delay the mandatory shore report while waiting for commercial approval. The flag, the coastal/port State and other relevant authorities can be informed in parallel according to the type of incident.
SOPEP/SMPEP contact appendix her sefer b: The SOPEP/SMPEP contact appendix should be checked before each voyage area; if the real numbers will not be called in a drill, their accuracy should be confirmed by another safe method.
İlk raporu yüzde yüz kesin veri gelene k: Holding back the initial report until one hundred per cent certain data are available
Olay sonrası record book sayfasını temiz: Replacing a record book page with a clean copy after the incident
2026 kayıp konteyner bildirimi ve MARPOL: 2026 lost container reporting and the MARPOL link
1 Ocak 2026 SOLAS değişiklikleri denize: The SOLAS amendments of 1 January 2026 strengthened the reporting of containers lost overboard. The main legal basis is SOLAS safety of navigation; however, a lost container can have MARPOL implications such as marine pollutants/dangerous goods, plastics and packaging, or fuel/chemical leakage. A SOLAS report therefore does not replace an environmental incident assessment.
Manifest ve stow plan'dan UN number, mar: The UN number, marine pollutant status, number of packages and approximate position are quickly extracted from the manifest and stowage plan. The initial number of containers may be an estimate; it is updated with the survey/tally and VDR/radar data. Cargo securing failure, heavy weather routing and the lashing condition enter the ISM corrective action process.
Kayıp önlenmesi; doğru VGM, stow/lashing: Preventing losses requires managing correct VGM, stowage/lashing calculations, the Cargo Securing Manual, weather avoidance, deck inspections and accelerometer/inclinometer trends together. The incident report should explain not only the number of boxes lost overboard but why the barriers failed.
Şirket acil durum planı, lost container: The company emergency plan should distribute the lost container data to the SOLAS navigational warning and MARPOL pollution report streams under a single incident identity.
SOLAS raporu gönderildiği için MARPOL de: Closing the MARPOL assessment because the SOLAS report has been sent
Konteyner içeriği belirsizken çevresel t: Assuming there is no environmental hazard while the container contents are uncertain
Tehlikeli yük konteyneri kaybı: Loss of a dangerous goods container
Ağır havada üç konteyner kaybolur; birin: Three containers are lost in heavy weather; one of them is listed as a marine pollutant in the manifest, and the exact last position is unknown.
Olay hem floating navigation hazard hem: The incident is both a floating hazard to navigation and a probable pollution incident. Instead of delaying the report because of the position uncertainty, it should be reported with the uncertainty range.
Gemi/insan emniyeti sağlanır, çevredeki: The safety of the ship/people is ensured, ships in the vicinity and the relevant coastal/flag channels are warned; the dangerous goods details are added in a follow-up, all time/position/cargo evidence is preserved and the lashing/routing root cause is investigated.
İstisna, önlenebilir planlama kusurunun: An exception is not an excuse for a preventable planning failure.
İlk rapor hızlı, sonraki raporlar gidere: The initial report should be fast, and later reports increasingly accurate.
Bir olay SOLAS ve birden fazla MARPOL ek: One incident can trigger SOLAS and more than one MARPOL annex at the same time.
Gemide bütünleşik MARPOL yönetimi ve den: Integrated MARPOL management on board and inspection cases
Güçlü MARPOL uyumu, her record book'u ay: Strong MARPOL compliance controls the flow of substances on board from the source to the final route, rather than filing each record book separately.
Her atık/emisyon akışı beş düğümle incel: Each waste/emission stream can be examined with five nodes: where it was generated, which tank/container held it, which equipment processed it, where it went and which record proves it. For oily bilge, the chain bilge well–holding tank–OWS–overboard/reception–ORB can be set up; for garbage, source station–storage–compactor/incinerator–shore/discharge–GRB.

ISGOTT (International Safety Guide for O: ISGOTT (International Safety Guide for Oil Tankers and Terminals) is published jointly by OCIMF (Oil Companies International Marine Forum), ICS (International Chamber of Shipping) and IAPH (International Association of Ports and Harbors). Its origin lies in combining the Tanker Safety Guide and terminal safety guides of the 1970s. It is not a mandatory IMO convention, but an industry guide regarded in practice as the global standard; it turns regulations such as SOLAS, MARPOL and the IGS requirements into practical operations. The latest edition is the 6th Edition published in 2020 (ISGOTT 6), notable for its human factors, ship-shore communication and updated Ship-Shore Safety Checklist (SSSCL) approach.

Kök neden, filo/gemi kapsamı, CAPA, soru: The root cause, fleet/ship extent, CAPA, person responsible/date and verification of effectiveness should be shown.

This strategy is the reflection of the Paris Climate Agreement in the maritime sector. Shipping is responsible for about 2.5-3% of global CO₂ emissions. To reach these targets, IMO is developing both technical (fuel standard) and market-based (carbon pricing) measures.

Her can filikası atanmış işletme ekibiyl: Each lifeboat is launched and manoeuvred in the water with its assigned operating crew (SOLAS III/19.3.4.3); the rescue boat is launched within this interval at the latest (III/19.3.4.6). The abandon ship drill itself is monthly.

If more than 25% of the crew have not taken part in drills on board in the previous month, the drills are held within 24 hours of leaving port. Crew members joining the ship are given training in the life-saving and fire-fighting appliances within two weeks at the latest (III/19.4.1). On passenger voyages longer than 24 hours, the passenger muster is held before or immediately upon departure (III/19.2.2). Each lifeboat is launched and manoeuvred in the water at least once every three months (III/19.3.4.3); the rescue boat is launched monthly where practicable and in any case at least once every three months (III/19.3.4.6). Enclosed space entry and rescue drills are held at least once every two months (III/19.3.3). Drills are recorded in the log-book (III/19.5).

A 4–20 mA transmitter has a live zero: t: A 4–20 mA transmitter has a live zero: the lower engineering value corresponds to 4 mA, not 0 mA. For linear scaling, the fraction of range is (I − 4)/16. Apply that fraction to the engineering span and then add the lower engineering value. This is a scaling calculation, not a diagnosis of the sensor; installation faults and out-of-range currents require the maker’s specified interpretation.

Reading a flow from the pump curve without considering the system curve leaves half of the problem unspecified.
A change in rolling behaviour, an unexpe: A change in rolling behaviour, an unexpected list or an inability to remain upright requires prompt assessment and reporting. Use available measurements, the loading instrument and approved stability or damage-control information, with qualified assistance where required.

It therefore produces one power stroke per two revolutions, assuming normal firing. Do not confuse shaft revolutions with firing events or the number of cylinders. This simple timing relation describes event frequency; it does not determine power output without the work per cycle and the other relevant engine conditions.
A four-stroke engine runs at 600 rpm. Fi: A four-stroke engine runs at 600 rpm. Find power strokes per minute for one cylinder.

A last known position is an observation: A last known position is an observation at a stated time, not necessarily the present search location. Drift and uncertainty grow with time; pass updates to the coordinating authority and revise the search plan as reliable information arrives.
A linear transmitter represents 0–200 °C: A linear transmitter represents 0–200 °C with 4–20 mA. What temperature corresponds to 12 mA?

A steady refrigeration cycle removes hea: A steady refrigeration cycle removes heat at the evaporator and rejects heat at the condenser. With other heat losses neglected, the condenser rejects both the evaporator load and the compressor work input: Qcond = Qevap + W. The refrigeration coefficient of performance is COP = Qevap / W. COP compares useful heat removal with work input; it is not a motor efficiency and can exceed one without violating energy conservation.
