Geminin DP kabiliyeti, görevin güvenli o: The vessel's DP capability does not by itself mean the task is safe.
DP Class 1, 2 veya 3 kabiliyetinin görev: Verify that the DP Class 1, 2 or 3 capability matches the requirements of the task and the vessel's actual technical condition.
Class sertifikası, DP notation, FMEA ve: Review the class certificate, the DP notation, the FMEA and the latest proving and annual trials reports.
Tek hata sonrası kaybedilebilecek jenera: Identify the generators, switchboards, thrusters, control computers, sensors and references that could be lost after a single failure.
WCFDI/WCF senaryosunu ve sonrasında elde: Confirm the WCFDI/WCF scenario and the thrust and power capacity remaining after it.
Online ekipmanın yedek gruplara doğru da: Check that the online equipment is correctly split between the redundancy groups and that common failure sources are isolated.
Görev için gerekli sınıf sağlanmıyorsa i: If the class required for the task is not available, do not start the work; TAM may be used only through an approved risk-based process.
Kâğıt üzerindeki yedeklilik, valf veya b: Redundancy that exists on paper may in practice have been lost because of a valve or bus-tie position.
Bakım dışı bırakılmış tek bir bileşen WC: A single component taken out of service for maintenance can change the WCF outcome.
Kritik faaliyette en hata toleranslı kon: For critical activities the most fault-tolerant configuration is managed with CAMO; for lower-risk tasks an accepted alternative configuration is managed with TAM.
Onaylı CAMO/TAM tablosundan güç üretimi,: From the approved CAMO/TAM table, take the required status of power generation, bus-ties, thrusters, PRS, sensors, UPS, cooling and auxiliary systems.
Köprüüstü, ECR ve görev kontrol merkezle: Confirm the selected mode jointly with the bridge, the ECR and the mission control centres.
Her ekipmanı tabloya göre line-up et ve: Line up each item of equipment to the table and have an independent person cross-check it.
Planlı bakım veya arıza nedeniyle sapma: If there is a deviation because of planned maintenance or a defect, assess the effect and record the approval and restrictions required.
Konfigürasyon değişince ASOG statüsünü v: When the configuration changes, reassess the ASOG status and the WCF outcome.
TAM, arızalı veya eksik yedekliliği otom: TAM does not automatically make defective or reduced redundancy acceptable.
CAMO/TAM değişikliği görev sürerken kont: A change between CAMO and TAM must not be made uncontrolled while a task is in progress.
Operasyonel, çevresel ve ekipman sınırla: Operational, environmental and equipment limits are defined in advance as Green, Advisory/Blue, Yellow and Red conditions and are acted on without delay when a trigger is reached.
ASOG'a hava, watch circle, jeneratör yük: Enter in the ASOG the limits for weather, watch circle, generator load, thrusters, PRS, sensors, communications and mission equipment.
Her satır için tetikleyici, bildirim, dü: For each line, write the trigger, the notification, the corrective action and the decision to stop or abandon the activity.
Başlamadan önce Master, DPO, Chief Engin: Before starting, review the table with the Master, the DPO, the Chief Engineer and those in charge of the mission.
Bir limit aşıldığında ilgili renge geç,: When a limit is exceeded, move to the corresponding colour, inform all parties and take the written action.
Şartlar düzelse bile yetkili onay ve yen: Even if conditions improve, do not return to a lower alert level without authorised approval and a fresh check.
Yellow veya Red durumda 'sistem hâlâ tut: In a Yellow or Red condition, operations are not continued on the grounds that 'the system is still holding'.
Alarm renklerinin anlamı gemiye özel ASO: The alert colours must be used in a way that does not conflict with the vessel-specific ASOG.
Liman çıkışı veya proje değişiminden son: After leaving port or a change of project, controlled tests confirm that the DP system is ready for the task.
Mobilizasyon checklistini proje, müşteri: Complete the mobilisation checklist for a new project or client, or after a long maintenance period.
Field arrival trials ile güç, thruster,: Use field arrival trials to verify the power, thruster, control, PRS, sensor, alarm and communication functions.
Pre-DP checklistte mevcut konfigürasyonu: In the pre-DP checklist, check that the current configuration matches the CAMO/TAM and the ASOG.
Son FMEA, annual trials ve arıza/defect: Check the latest FMEA, the annual trials and the defect list for any open restrictions.
Master ve Chief Engineer onayı olmadan p: Do not give permission to commence operations without the approval of the Master and the Chief Engineer.
Sadece self-test sonucu, itki ve güç zin: A self-test result alone does not prove how the thrust and power chain performs under real load.
Checklist kutu işaretleme faaliyeti deği: A checklist is a process of physical verification, not an exercise in ticking boxes.
Offshore tesise yaklaşım; izin, kaçış ro: The approach to an offshore installation is made safely with permission, an escape route, a blow-on/blow-off assessment and a gradual reduction in speed.
Saha bilgilerini, batimetriyi, sualtı ya: Study the field information, the bathymetry, the subsea structures and mooring lines, and the movements of the installation.
Kontrollü sahaya ve 500 m bölgesine giri: Obtain permission from the installation to enter the controlled field and the 500 m zone, and complete the pre-entry checklist.
Baş, rüzgâr-akıntı yönü, WCF sonrası sür: Determine the heading, the wind and current directions, the drift after the WCF and the lowest-risk escape route.
DP'yi bölge dışında kurup sistemi stabil: Set up DP outside the zone and let the system settle; bring in the second independent reference for the last 250 m.
Son mevkiye kısa adımlar ve yerleşme ara: Move to the final position in short steps with settling pauses; reduce the approach speed and step size in line with the field procedure.
Final mevkide watch circle, thrust/power: At the final position, verify again the watch circle, the thrust and power margins, communications and the green-light conditions.
Kaçış rotası planlanmadan çalışma sahası: Do not enter the work site until an escape route has been planned.
Drift-on yaklaşım, tek arızada tesise te: A drift-on approach increases the risk of contact with the installation after a single failure; the reason for choosing it must be clearly stated in the risk assessment.
Thrusterların gerçek tepki yönü kanıtlan: The real response direction of each thruster is proved, control is handed over gradually and time is allowed for the mathematical model to build up.
Her thruster ve ana pervaneyi manuel kon: Prove each thruster and main propeller in both directions under manual control; compare the command, the feedback and the physical response.
Gyro, MRU/VRS, rüzgâr sensörü ve seçilen: Check that the gyros, MRU/VRS, wind sensors and selected PRS are healthy and correctly weighted.
Önce Auto Yaw ile başı stabilize et, ard: First steady the heading in Auto Yaw, then put the surge and sway axes into Auto Position in a controlled way.
Pozisyon setpointini mevcut mevkiye yakı: Choose a position setpoint close to the present position; do not order a sudden large setpoint or heading change.
Modelin çevresel kuvvetleri öğrenmesi iç: Hold the vessel steady long enough for the model to learn the environmental forces, and monitor the actual performance.
Capability, consequence analysis ve foot: Do not start work until the capability, consequence analysis and footprint values show the expected behaviour.
Yanlış pitch/azimuth geri bildirimi kont: Wrong pitch or azimuth feedback can cause sudden movement when control is handed over.
Model build-up sırasında gereksiz manevr: Avoid unnecessary manoeuvres and changes of task while the model is building up.
Mutlak ve göreceli referanslar, ortak ha: Absolute and relative references are chosen so as to reduce the chance of a common failure and are verified independently throughout the operation.
Görev ve su derinliğine göre DGNSS, HPR/: Choose a combination of DGNSS, HPR/USBL, taut wire, laser, microwave or relative PRS to suit the task and the water depth.
Aynı uydu/düzeltme kaynağını kullanan ik: Bear in mind that two GNSS receivers using the same satellites or correction source may not be independent of a common failure.
Referansların koordinat datumunu, hedef: Verify the coordinate datum of each reference, the target identity, the antenna and lever-arm values and the installation offsets.
Yeni referansı önce monitor konumunda gö: Watch a new reference in monitor mode first; enable it in a controlled way only if its residual, variance and trend are consistent.
Bir referans saparsa hemen deselect etme: If a reference drifts, rather than deselecting it at once, compare common sensor, target, geometry and environmental causes.
Referans ağırlıklarını üretici kılavuzu: Manage the reference weightings in line with the manufacturer's manual and the vessel's procedure.
Yanlış hedef seçimi veya multipath, doğr: Choosing the wrong target, or multipath, can produce a relative position that looks right but is dangerous.
Tek referansa fark edilmeden düşmek ASOG: Dropping to a single reference without noticing can change the ASOG status.
Gyro, MRU/VRS ve rüzgâr sensörü verileri: Keeping the gyro, MRU/VRS and wind sensor data accurate and redundant prevents wrong inputs reaching the DP model.
Tüm gyroları manyetik pusula, GNSS headi: Compare all gyros with the magnetic compass, GNSS heading or other independent sources.
MRU/VRS roll-pitch verilerini ve mount/l: Check the MRU/VRS roll and pitch data and the mounting and lever-arm parameters.
Rüzgâr sensörlerinin gölgelenme, egzoz v: For the heading in use, assess whether the wind sensors are exposed to shielding, exhaust or the effect of structures.
Sensör fark alarmında hatalı kaynağı tre: On a sensor difference alarm, identify the faulty source using trends, voting and independent observation.
Sensör devre dışı bırakıldığında consequ: When a sensor is taken out of use, check the consequence analysis and the ASOG status again.
Ortak besleme veya ortak veri yolu, fizi: A common power supply or a common data bus can turn physically separate sensors into a single point of failure.
Rüzgâr feed-forward hatası gereksiz ve t: An error in the wind feed-forward can produce unnecessary thrust, or thrust in the wrong direction.
Tahmini kabiliyet, tek hata sonrası sonu: The predicted capability, the outcome after a single failure and the vessel's actual station-keeping performance are assessed together.
Capability plot üzerinde mevcut draft, t: On the capability plot, check the margin available for the present draught, thruster configuration and environmental direction.
Online consequence analysis'in switchboa: Verify that the online consequence analysis correctly detects the switchboard, generator and thruster status.
WCF sonrası elde kalan güç ve itkinin op: Check whether the power and thrust remaining after the WCF meet the operating limits.
Footprint plot ile gerçek pozisyon-baş d: Use the footprint plot to record the actual spread of position and heading, the thrust used and the environmental trend.
Model ile saha performansı uyuşmazsa lim: If the model and the performance on site do not agree, reduce the limits, investigate the cause and act according to the ASOG.
Capability plot tahmindir; ani squall, s: A capability plot is a prediction; it may not fully reflect a sudden squall, a soliton, thruster derating or interaction.
Consequence analysis'in 'green' olması y: A 'green' consequence analysis does not make up for a wrong configuration input.
DPO vardiya değişiminde gemi, sistem, gö: At a DPO watch handover the status of the vessel, systems, task and environment is passed on in full; during a critical phase, monitoring is continuous.
Mevki, baş, setpoint, watch circle, çevr: Hand over the position, heading, setpoint, watch circle, environment and any expected change in weather and current.
Online jeneratör, thruster, PRS, sensör,: Report the status of the online generators, thrusters, PRS, sensors, DP controllers and UPS.
CAMO/TAM, ASOG rengi, açık alarm/defect,: Explain the CAMO/TAM mode, the ASOG colour, open alarms and defects, bypasses and maintenance in progress.
Dalış, ROV, hat gerilimi, riser, gangway: Confirm with the mission control centre the status of diving, ROV, line tension, riser, gangway, cargo hose or lifting.
Planlanan gemi/helikopter hareketleri, S: Hand over planned vessel and helicopter movements, SIMOPS and the emergency escape route.
Devralan DPO sistemi anlayıp kabul ettik: Once the relieving DPO has understood and accepted the system, both sign the checklist.
Kritik yaklaşım, bağlantı, kaldırma veya: Do not hand over the watch during a critical approach, connection, lift or response to a failure.
DP konsolundaki DPO aynı anda başka idar: The DPO at the DP console must not be given other administrative work at the same time.
Advisory, Yellow veya Red tetikleyiciler: On an Advisory, Yellow or Red trigger, the pre-planned response is carried out, putting the safety of people, equipment and the installation first.
Alarmı tanı, acknowledge etmeden önce ka: Recognise the alarm; read its source and time before acknowledging it; check the position and heading trends.
ASOG statüsünü ilan edip Master, ECR ve: Declare the ASOG status and inform the Master, the ECR and the mission control centres on the designated channel.
Yellow durumda faaliyeti güvenli safhaya: In a Yellow condition, bring the activity to a safe stage and start the preparatory action for the diving bell, ROV, gangway, hose or load.
Red veya kontrolsüz hareket halinde acil: In a Red condition or uncontrolled movement, carry out the emergency disconnection or recovery, manual or independent joystick control, or the escape manoeuvre according to the plan.
Alarm, DP, PMS/VMS ve iletişim kayıtları: Preserve the alarm, DP, PMS/VMS and communication records; after an incident, obtain authority to restart through the formal process.
Nedeni araştırmak için acil eylemi gecik: Delaying emergency action to investigate the cause can lead to contact or damage to an umbilical or riser.
Yanlış kontrol moduna geçiş drive-off'u: Changing to the wrong control mode can make a drive-off worse; these duties must be practised in drills.
Aynı sahadaki eşzamanlı faaliyetlerin bi: The hazards that simultaneous activities in the same field pose to one another are identified in advance and managed under a single interface plan.
Dalış, ROV, crane, drilling, supply, hel: Identify conflicts between diving, ROV, crane, drilling, supply, helicopter and bunkering operations and other vessel movements.
Tüm taraflarla SIMOPS toplantısı yap; ki: Hold a SIMOPS meeting with all parties; write down who has priority authority over operations, the PTW and communications.
İletişim kanallarını, çağrı adlarını, al: Agree the communication channels, call signs, alert words, the action on loss of communications and joint emergency arrangements.
Interface/bridging document ile prosedür: Resolve differences between procedures and SMS with an interface or bridging document.
Günlük koordinasyon toplantısında hava,: At the daily coordination meeting, update the weather, the schedule, isolations, vessel movements and the ASOG status.
Bir tarafın green durumu diğer tarafın f: One party being in green does not mean that another party's activity is safe.
Belirsiz komuta zinciri acil ayırma kara: An unclear chain of command delays the decision to disconnect in an emergency.
Su derinliğinin referans geometrisi, thr: Limits are adjusted after assessing the effect of the water depth on the reference geometry, thruster efficiency and environmental forces.
Sığ suda taut-wire açı sınırı, HPR çoklu: In shallow water, consider the taut-wire angle limit, HPR multipath and thruster interaction with the seabed and current.
Derin suda acoustic geometri, sinyal gec: In deep water, check the acoustic geometry, the signal delay, the beacon tilt and whether a taut wire can be used.
Kuvvetli tide ve eddy için hız-yön trend: With strong tidal streams and eddies, monitor the speed and direction trends, the thrust margin and reference deviations.
Soliton riski olan sahada radar/akıntı i: In a field where solitons may occur, watch for signs of them on radar and in the current, and for the chance of a sudden surge.
Çevre limiti yaklaşınca görev ekipmanını: As an environmental limit is approached, recover the mission equipment safely and take the ASOG action without delay.
Soliton geçişi çok kısa sürede pozisyon: A passing soliton can cause a position and heading excursion within a very short time.
Dalış çanı ve dalgıçların sualtı yapılar: The diving bell and divers are kept at a safe distance from subsea structures and thrusters and can be recovered safely after the WCF.
Dalış öncesi CAMO, pre-dive/periodic DP: Before diving, complete the CAMO set-up, the pre-dive and periodic DP checklists and the permission to commence operations.
Bell, diver, downline, habitat, mooring: Show the bell, divers, downlines, habitat, mooring lines and subsea obstructions on the DP display or plot.
Dive control ile green light, dalgıç/çan: Keep dive control continuously informed of the green light, the diver and bell status, the working depth and the recovery time.
Tending point'e göre yasaklı thrusterlar: Apply the prohibited thrusters and thrust limits for the tending point using the approved procedure.
Baş veya mevki değişikliğini önceden div: Tell dive control in advance about any change of heading or position; do not move without clear approval.
Yellow/Red durumda dalış çanı geri alma: In a Yellow or Red condition, start the bell recovery and emergency rescue plan according to the ASOG.
Thruster suction/discharge akımı ve perv: Thruster suction and wash, and contact with a propeller, are fatal.
Anchor chain, mooring line ve diğer down: Anchor chains, mooring lines and other downlines are an entanglement hazard for divers and umbilicals.
ROV/TMS/umbilical geometrisi korunurken: While the ROV, TMS and umbilical geometry is protected, the vessel is held in a fixed position or moved smoothly and predictably along a defined track.
Launch/recovery, çalışma mevkii, TMS ve: Plan the launch and recovery, the working position, the TMS and the umbilical route with ROV control.
Taut wire, acoustic transducer, dalış ha: Check for clashes with the taut wire, acoustic transducers, dive lines and other over-side equipment.
ROV acoustic responder ile gemi PRS kayn: Verify that the ROV acoustic responder and the vessel's PRS sources are compatible in frequency and update rate.
Move/heading change taleplerini küçük ar: Carry out requested moves and heading changes in small steps and get confirmation from ROV control at each step.
Kayıp telemetry, aşırı umbilical tension: On loss of telemetry, excessive umbilical tension or a DP degradation, apply the recovery or abandon criteria.
Platforma yakın açık güverte ve bulk kar: Deck and bulk cargo transfers close to a platform are carried out with a short terminate time and a clear escape route kept open.
Kargo planı, hortum/loose cargo düzeni,: Confirm the cargo plan, the hose and loose cargo arrangement, the platform crane plan and the communication channel between the parties.
Mümkünse drift-off/blow-off çalışma sekt: Where possible, choose a drift-off or blow-off working sector; assess the escape direction together with the cargo hoses and the installation's obstructions.
Final mevkide relative ve absolute refer: At the final position, compare the relative and absolute references and monitor the environmental limits and thrust margin against the ASOG.
Hortum, crane load ve personel güvertede: While hoses are connected, a crane load is in the air or people are on deck, do not change the setpoint or heading without permission.
Hava, güç, thruster, PRS veya hortum ger: If a weather, power, thruster, PRS or hose tension limit is exceeded, stop the transfer, disconnect the lines and move to a safe distance.
Bağlı bulk hose veya askıdaki yük, gemin: A connected bulk hose or a suspended load can restrict the vessel's escape manoeuvre.
Anchor veya tow wire üzerindeki yatay ku: While the horizontal force on the anchor or tow wire is being taken, the vessel's position, heading, stability and deck working area are kept under control.
Rig move/anchor pattern, bollard pull, l: Plan the rig move and anchor pattern, bollard pull, line tension, water depth, catenary and seabed obstructions.
Tow/anchor kuvvetini DP capability hesab: Include the tow or anchor force in the DP capability calculation; check the thrust and power margins for the post-WCF condition as well.
Shark jaw, towing pin, winch, load cell,: Test the shark jaw, towing pins, winch, load cell, stern roller and emergency release systems.
DPO, winch operator, deck foreman ve tes: Set up a standard system of commands and confirmations between the DPO, the winch operator, the deck foreman and the installation.
High tension altında line-of-fire alanın: Keep the line-of-fire area clear under high tension; continuously monitor the wire direction and changes in tension.
Aşırı tension, stabilite limiti, power/t: On excessive tension, reaching a stability limit, a power or thruster degradation or loss of command, carry out the emergency release or abort plan.
Tow wire yatay bileşeni DP'nin kullanıla: The horizontal component of the tow wire force can use up the DP's available thrust margin.
Güvertede snap-back, bight ve line-of-fi: Snap-back zones, bights and line-of-fire areas on deck are a deadly hazard.
Boru hattındaki overbend, sagbend ve tou: The vessel is moved ahead in a controlled way along a predefined corridor while the overbend, sagbend and touchdown stresses in the pipeline are kept within limits.
Route, bathymetry, crossing, lay directi: Load the route, bathymetry, crossings, lay direction and the permitted corridor and heading limits.
Tensioner, stinger, abandonment/recovery: Verify the tensioner, stinger, abandonment and recovery winch and load-cell data against the DP and operations displays.
Lay tension ve touchdown point limitleri: Link the lay tension and touchdown point limits to the ASOG.
S-lay'de joint boyuna uygun incremental: In S-lay, use incremental moves matched to the joint length; in J-lay or reel-lay, use auto-track at an approved low speed.
Kaynak/üretim gecikmesi, tension kaybı,: In the event of a welding or production delay, loss of tension, a DP excursion or the WCF, start the hold, laydown or abandonment procedure.
Ani surge veya hız değişimi pipe buckle: A sudden surge or change of speed creates a risk of pipe buckling and abandonment.
DP setpoint hareketi, firing line ve ten: Do not move the DP setpoint without confirmation from the firing line and the tensioner team.
Seabed aracı, fall-pipe, draghead, ploug: The vessel is held in a static position or on a low-speed track while the seabed vehicle, fall-pipe, draghead, plough or cable catenary is monitored.
Görev aracının konumunu, tow/umbilical k: Define the position of the work vehicle, the tow or umbilical force and the permitted cross-track error.
Araca ait relative sensör veya load-cell: Before connecting the vehicle's relative sensor or load-cell data to the DP, verify its scaling, direction and failure mode.
Auto-track hızını seabed aracı, ürün akı: Limit the auto-track speed to suit the seabed vehicle, the product flow and the recovery capacity.
Rock dumping'de survey doğrulamasıyla ço: In rock dumping, follow the multi-pass plan with survey verification; in cable work, monitor the catenary and the minimum bend radius.
Araç takılması, tension artışı, telemetr: If the vehicle gets stuck, the tension rises, telemetry is lost or the DP degrades, carry out the stop and recovery plan.
SPM, SAL, OLS, STL veya tandem loading s: During SPM, SAL, OLS, STL or tandem loading, a safe sector and distance relative to the terminal are kept, and the hawser and hose loads are kept within limits.
Loading konseptini, weather-vaning merke: Determine the loading concept, the weather-vaning centre, the approach sector and the absolute and relative PRS required.
Hawser tension, hose envelope, terminal: Test the hawser tension, the hose envelope, the terminal offset and the ESD/ERS functions.
FSO/FPSO hareketini ve geminin coğrafi m: Monitor the movement of the FSO/FPSO and the vessel's geographical position together; verify the divergence alarm limits.
Drive-off/drift-off, hawser overload vey: Match the alarms for drive-off, drift-off, hawser overload and loss of relative PRS to the ASOG actions.
Yellow/Red durumda transferi durdur, ESD: In a Yellow or Red condition, stop the transfer and carry out the ESD/ERS and departure sequence according to the approved terminal procedure.
Hawser tension ve hose limiti aşılırsa k: If the hawser tension and hose limits are exceeded, a cargo spill and a collision can develop at the same time.
Riser/flex-joint açıları, watch circle v: Long-term station-keeping is achieved by keeping the riser and flex-joint angles within the watch circle and disconnect criteria.
Wellhead, riser, flex-joint ve seabed ya: Verify the coordinates and datum of the wellhead, riser, flex-joint and seabed structures.
İzin verilen riser angle, watch circle,: Enter in the ASOG the permitted riser angle, watch circle, excursion and emergency disconnect limits.
Deepwater için bağımsız surface ve subse: For deep water, assess the combination of independent surface and subsea PRS, the acoustic geometry and common-mode failures.
Riser angle monitoring ile DP pozisyon t: Monitor the riser angle and the DP position trend together; use relaxed position or heading only within the approved envelope.
WCF, drive-off/drift-off veya çevresel l: On the WCF, a drive-off or drift-off, or an environmental limit, carry out the sequence to secure the well, disconnect and take the escape route.
Mevki toleransı içinde kalmak riser açıs: Staying within the position tolerance does not necessarily mean that the riser angle is safe.
Disconnect için gereken süre çevre ve WC: If the time needed to disconnect is longer than the environmental and WCF scenario allows, the operating envelope is not acceptable.
Personel transferinde gangway'in hareket: During personnel transfer the gangway's motion and load limits are respected, and the vessel is held in a safe relative position to a fixed or moving installation.
Gangway landing pointini DP center of ro: Define the gangway landing point together with the DP centre of rotation and the movement of the installation.
Relative PRS, heave compensation, gangwa: Test the relative PRS, the heave compensation, the gangway stroke and the warning and trip limits.
Facility footprint ile gemi watch circle: Compare the installation's footprint with the vessel's watch circle and its movement after the WCF.
Transfer boyunca DPO, gangway operator v: Throughout the transfer, keep uninterrupted communication between the DPO, the gangway operator and the installation's control room.
Limit yaklaşımında yeni geçişi durdur; Y: As a limit is approached, stop new crossings; on Yellow or Red, or a gangway trip, carry out the planned disconnection and recovery.
Gangway bağlıyken kontrolsüz excursion c: An uncontrolled excursion while the gangway is connected causes serious injury to personnel and structural damage.
Tesisin hareketi relative PRS ve gangway: The movement of the installation can cause a common failure in the relative PRS and the gangway sensors.
Askıdaki yükün kuvveti ve gemi ağırlık m: The force of the suspended load and the sudden change in the vessel's centre of gravity are included in the DP control, stability and station-keeping plan.
Lift plan, yük ağırlığı/CoG, crane radiu: Verify the lift plan, the load weight and CoG, the crane radius, the environmental limits and the landing tolerance.
Crane load kuvveti ile hook-load değişim: Assess the effect of the crane load force and changes in hook load on the DP model and the power demand.
Barge/gemi, hedef tesis ve yük için orta: Confirm the shared communications and the stop-work command for the barge or vessel, the target installation and the load.
Pick-up, slew, transfer ve landing safha: During the pick-up, slew, transfer and landing phases, monitor the position, heading, thrust, list and hook-load trends.
Yükün ani alınması/bırakılması öncesi DP: Warn the DPO before a load is suddenly picked up or released; change the setpoint and gain only as planned.
DP, crane, rigging veya hava limiti aşıl: If a DP, crane, rigging or weather limit is exceeded, move the load to the designated safe position.
Ani hook-load değişimi list, draft ve DP: A sudden change in hook load can instantly change the list, the draught and the DP thrust demand.
Yük ile tesis arasındaki sıkışma alanına: Personnel must not enter the crush zone between the load and the installation.
DP sisteminin varsayılan yedekliliği ana: The redundancy assumed for the DP system is proved by analysis and controlled tests, and the findings are carried into the operational configuration.
FMEA'daki failure mode, detection, isola: Compare the failure modes, detection, isolation, alarms and end effects in the FMEA with the vessel's present architecture.
Proving trials ve annual trials sonuçlar: Follow up open findings, limitations and recommendations from the proving trials and annual trials.
Kritik testleri üretici, class ve şirket: Plan critical tests with the manufacturer, class and company procedures; do not inject failures uncontrolled during a task.
Test sonucunun CAMO, ASOG, consequence a: Assess the effect of the test results on the CAMO, the ASOG, the consequence analysis and emergency drills.
Modifikasyon veya tekrarlayan arıza sonr: After a modification or a recurring failure, update the FMEA as a living document.
Eski FMEA veya kapatılmamış trial bulgus: An out-of-date FMEA or an unclosed trial finding gives a false impression of redundancy.
Canlı operasyonda yapılan plansız trip t: An unplanned trip test during a live operation can lead to a loss of position.
Gemiye özel DP bilgisi tek kaynaktan eri: Vessel-specific DP information is kept up to date in a single accessible source and is understood by the watch team.
DP Operations Manual, FMEA, trials, capa: Check the revisions of the DP Operations Manual, the FMEA, trials, capability plots, CAMO/TAM, the ASOG and the manufacturers' manuals.
Interface/bridging document, project pro: Keep current copies of the interface or bridging document, the project procedures and the field drawings ready at the DP station.
DP loguna DP'ye giriş/çıkış zamanı, göre: Record in the DP log the times of going on and off DP, the task, position, heading, online equipment, PRS, environment, alarms and changes of status.
Bakım, bypass, defect, test ve drill kay: Link the maintenance, bypass, defect, test and drill records to the relevant technical file.
Eski revizyonları kullanım dışı olarak i: Mark old revisions as superseded and update the document distribution list.
Eksik saat sıralaması olay incelemesinde: Gaps in the timeline mean that critical evidence is lost in an incident investigation.
Loss of position, loss of automatic cont: The root causes of loss of position, loss of automatic control, undesired events and downtime are investigated with the evidence preserved.
Önce insanları ve görevi güvenli duruma: First make the people and the task safe; start the required external notifications through the Master and the company.
DP, PMS/VMS, alarm, trend, VDR, iletişim: Preserve the DP, PMS/VMS, alarm, trend, VDR and communication records and screenshots, with time stamps.
Olay anındaki iş, çevre, control mode, s: Record the work, environment, control mode and the status of the switchboards, generators, thrusters, PRS and sensors at the time of the incident.
Sequence of events ile initiating event,: Use the sequence of events to separate the initiating event, hidden failures, human factors and barrier failures.
Düzeltici/önleyici faaliyetleri sorumlu: Set corrective and preventive actions with a person responsible and a deadline; update the FMEA, the ASOG, procedures and training needs.
Şirket sürecine göre IMCA station-keepin: Consider sharing the station-keeping event with IMCA in line with the company process.
Sadece son arızalı parçayı bulmak kök ne: Finding only the last part that failed is not a root cause analysis.
Gemide kurulu Bridge Mate DP sisteminin: The distributed architecture, module boundaries and redundancy and segregation philosophy of the Bridge Mate DP system installed on board are understood before planning operations and assessing failures.
Sistemin hangi Bridge Mate seviyesinde (: Verify from the class certificate and the MT delivery documentation which Bridge Mate level the system is (JX, DP 0, DP 1, DP 2, DP 3).
Operatör istasyonu, DP kontrol bilgisaya: Mark on the general arrangement plan the physical location on board of the operator stations, DP control computers and IO units.
Her IO ünitesinin hangi thruster, refera: List which thrusters, reference systems, power supplies and sensor groups each IO unit serves.
Redundancy (yedeklilik) ve segregation (: Check that the redundancy and segregation boundaries match the redundancy groups defined in the FMEA.
Dağıtık mimaride bir IO ünitesi veya ağ: Include in the WCF scenario which equipment would be lost if one IO unit or one network branch of the distributed architecture failed.
Üretici genel mimari broşürü, gemiye öze: The manufacturer's general architecture brochure is no substitute for the vessel-specific FMEA and commissioning documents; the exact configuration is verified on board.
Dağıtık IO mimarisi kablolamayı azaltır;: A distributed IO architecture reduces cabling, but equipment grouped on a single IO unit can create a common point of failure.
Bridge Mate ürün ailesindeki sınıf farkl: The differences between classes in the Bridge Mate product family (the number of control computers, operator stations and IO units, and the need for a separate compartment) are compared with the vessel's actual DP notation.
JX joystick ve DP 0 sistemlerinin DP 1/2: Understand that the JX joystick and DP 0 systems share the same distributed architecture as DP 1, 2 and 3; the difference is the number of modules.
DP 1'de tek kontrol bilgisayarı ve tek o: Verify that DP 1 has one control computer and one operator station, and that an independent joystick system can be interfaced separately.
DP 2'de üç kontrol bilgisayarının majori: Confirm from the operator manual that in DP 2 the three control computers use majority voting and that a faulty computer is rejected by the system.
DP 2'de her sensör seti, her PRS, güç ka: Check that in DP 2 there is a separate IO unit for each sensor set, each PRS, each power supply and each thruster, and that the modules are connected by a redundant dual network.
DP 3'te en az üç operatör istasyonu, üç: In DP 3, locate at least three operator stations and three IO sets, plus the control computer, operator station and sensor IO unit in a separate fire-resistant compartment.
Donanımın DP 2 kapasitesinde olması, kon: Hardware capable of DP 2 does not mean that DP 2 redundancy actually exists until the configuration and maintenance status have been verified.
DP 3'te ayrı kompartımanın yangın veya s: In DP 3, if the fire or watertight integrity of the separate compartment is breached, the segregation required by class is lost in practice.
DPO'nun kullandığı operatör istasyonu ti: The type of operator station the DPO uses (console, compact operator station or DP Chair) is used correctly with regard to the watch arrangement, line of sight and handover practice.
Gemideki istasyon tipini belirle: konsol: Identify the type of station on board: the console version, the compact operator station, or the DP Chair with a 15-inch touch screen built into the armrest.
DP Chair'de manuel, joystick ve DP kontr: Note that the DP Chair brings manual, joystick and DP control together in one place, and that the chair can be configured as a DP 1 or DP 2 operator station.
Çok istasyonlu kurulumda hangi istasyonu: In a multi-station installation, confirm at the start of each watch which station is in command and how control is transferred.
Multi-Function Workstation'da DP dışında: On a Multi-Function Workstation, make sure DP monitoring continues without interruption while applications other than DP are open.
Ekran parlaklığını merkezi dimming ile g: Use central dimming to set the screen brightness to a level that does not spoil night vision; do not turn down the alarm volume.
Kompakt veya koltuk tipi istasyonda ekra: Being close to the screen and joystick at a compact or chair-type station does not replace keeping a lookout outside.
Dokunmatik ekranda yanlış dokunma riski: Because of the risk of an accidental touch on a touch screen, critical mode changes must include a confirmation step.
Kontrol devri belirsiz kalırsa iki istas: If the transfer of control is unclear, conflicting commands may be given from two stations.
Bridge Mate DP'ye bağlı mutlak ve görece: The absolute and relative references connected to the Bridge Mate DP are chosen and monitored so that they complement each other and do not create a common failure.
Gemide kurulu PRS setini çıkar: DGPS/GNS: List the PRS fitted on board: DGPS/GNSS, the radar-based RadaScan, the laser-based CyScan, hydroacoustic, taut wire and so on.
RadaScan'in yakın mesafe çalışmada GPS/D: Reflect in the task plan that RadaScan complements GPS/DGPS for close-range work and works with high accuracy in the 10 m–1000 m range.
CyScan'i birincil veya yedek lokal refer: When bringing CyScan in as the primary or back-up local reference, verify the line of sight to the target or reflector and the mounting geometry.
Her referansı DP'ye almadan önce bağımsı: Compare each reference independently before bringing it into the DP; investigate why a reference is drifting further before deselecting it.
Ortak hata riskini azalt: aynı uydu takı: Reduce the risk of a common failure: do not count references that depend on the same satellite constellation, the same correction service or the same target structure as redundancy on their own.
Reflektör veya hedef gölgelenmesi, gemi: Shadowing of a reflector or target, vessel motion or a structure blocking the view can cause a local reference to be lost suddenly.
GNSS bozulması (scintillation, jamming,: GNSS degradation (scintillation, jamming, spoofing) can affect all satellite-based references at the same time.
Kritik faaliyet tek referansla sürdürülm: Do not continue a critical activity on a single reference.
DP kontrolü ile köprüüstü seyir uygulama: In installations where DP control and bridge navigation applications run on the same Multi-Function Workstation platform, separation of tasks and data integrity are maintained.
Her MFW'nin tüm uygulamaları paralel çal: Verify that each MFW runs all applications in parallel and is connected to redundant networks, so that a single point of failure is designed out.
Radar, ECDIS, autopilot, conning ve rota: At the start of the watch, record at which station the radar, ECDIS, autopilot, conning and route planning applications are selected.
Track control ve otomatik rota tutmadan: Define clearly at which point control is handed over when changing from track control and automatic course keeping to DP mode.
Captain mode ile kaydedilen kişisel terc: Check that the personal settings saved in Captain mode load the right profile for transit, berthing and DP operations.
IBS'in PMS, otomasyon ve alarm sistemiyl: Where the IBS is integrated with the PMS, automation and alarm system, verify that DP-related alarms are not suppressed on the bridge.
Tek ekranda çok uygulama, DP gözetiminin: Many applications on one screen can push DP monitoring into the visual background.
Kaptan profili değişimi ekran düzenini d: When switching to another Master's profile changes the screen layout, critical DP indications may be missed.
One-man bridge operation onayı, DP opera: An approval for one-man bridge operation does not automatically apply to DP operations.
Manuel kontrolden joystick ve otomatik D: Changes from manual control to joystick and automatic DP mode are made gradually, proving the thruster response and allowing the mathematical model to settle.
Bağımsız joystick sisteminin Bridge Mate: Verify that the independent joystick system is a control path separate from the Bridge Mate DP and provides back-up manoeuvring if the DP fails.
DP'ye almadan önce her thruster ve ana p: Before going on DP, prove each thruster and main propeller in both directions under manual control; compare the command, the feedback and the physical response.
Joystick modunda otomatik baş kontrolünü: In joystick mode, engage automatic heading control and watch the vessel's response; then add position control.
Tam otomatik mevki tutmaya geçtikten son: After changing to fully automatic position keeping, allow time for the model to settle and learn the environmental forces.
Her mod geçişini, komuttaki istasyonu ve: Record each mode change, the station in command and the time in the DP log; have a second person monitor during the change.
Model oturmadan görev başlatılırsa ilk ç: If a task is started before the model has settled, a marked position excursion may occur at the first change in the environment.
Thruster prove edilmeden DP'ye geçiş, te: Going on DP without proving the thrusters risks a drive-off from a unit producing thrust in the wrong direction without anyone noticing.
Mod geçişi kritik safhada (dalgıç suda,: Do not change mode during a critical phase (divers in the water, a load suspended).
Jeneratör, switchboard, bus-tie, thruste: The generators, switchboards, bus-ties, thrusters and auxiliary systems are put into a fault-tolerant configuration that will maintain station-keeping after the WCF.
FMEA, CAMO/TAM ve tek hat şemasından red: Verify the redundancy group boundaries from the FMEA, the CAMO/TAM and the single-line diagram.
Jeneratör ve thrusterları yedek gruplara: Spread the generators and thrusters evenly between the redundancy groups; calculate the capacity remaining after the expected WCF.
Bus-tie, breaker, protection, earthing v: Check the bus-tie, breaker, protection, earthing and blackout recovery settings against the operating mode.
Fuel, starting air, cooling, ventilation: Line up the common points in the fuel, starting air, cooling, ventilation and control power systems.
ECR ile köprüüstü CAMO checklistini karş: Complete the CAMO checklist jointly between the ECR and the bridge, and report technical readiness.
Tek bir ortak açık valf veya crossover i: A single open common valve or crossover can expose two redundancy groups to the same failure.
Kâğıt üzerindeki generator sayısı, yanlı: The number of generators on paper does not make up for a wrong breaker topology.
DP talebi değişirken frekans, yük paylaş: As the DP demand changes, overload and blackout are prevented by maintaining the frequency, load sharing and enough spinning reserve.
PMS'nin running/standby jeneratörleri, l: Verify that the PMS correctly sees the running and standby generators, the load-dependent start sequence and the breaker status.
Governor/AVR load sharing ile her redund: Monitor the governor and AVR load sharing and the kW and kVAr distribution within each redundancy group.
ASOG'daki generator, switchboard ve thru: Apply the generator, switchboard and thruster load limits in the ASOG; compare the 80 per cent figure in the DP presentation with the limits in the vessel's procedure.
En büyük online jeneratör veya grup kayb: Monitor the spinning reserve, which assesses the frequency and remaining capacity after loss of the largest online generator or group.
Yük trendi limite yaklaşmadan standby je: Start and synchronise the standby generator before the load trend reaches the limit; inform the bridge.
Sadece toplam plant yüzdesine bakmak bir: Looking only at the total plant percentage can hide a local overload on one switchboard group.
Standby jeneratörün talep halinde doğru: Verify that on demand the standby generator starts in the right order, connects to the busbar and accepts a sudden DP load.
Starting air/battery, fuel, jacket water: Check the starting air or battery, fuel, jacket water preheating and lube oil pre-lubrication conditions.
Auto-start permissive, start failure, sy: Test the auto-start permissives, start failure, synchronisation and breaker closing logic according to the test programme.
Load acceptance/rejection performansını: Compare the load acceptance and load rejection performance with the FMEA and the manufacturer's limits.
Failed start veya slow start bulgusunu A: Reflect a failed or slow start in the ASOG status and update the standby sequence.
Testten sonra tüm selector, breaker ve a: After the test, return all selectors, breakers and alarm bypasses to their operating positions.
Soğuk motorun kâğıt üzerindeki standby d: A cold engine shown as standby on paper is not a real fast-acting standby.
Açık veya kapalı bus işletmesinin FMEA i: Open or closed bus operation is kept within the limits proved by the FMEA, so that a failure does not spread between redundancy groups.
Operasyon için onaylı bus topolojisini C: Verify the approved bus topology for the operation from the CAMO and the single-line diagram.
Bus-tie breaker protection, interlock, d: Check the bus-tie breaker protection, interlocks, differential protection and blackout prevention functions.
Closed-bus kullanılıyorsa FMEA/proving t: If closed bus is used, confirm that the fault ride-through and isolation assumptions of the FMEA and proving trials are met.
Planlı switching için risk değerlendirme: For planned switching, carry out a risk assessment, obtain the permission of the DPO and the Master and, if possible, stop the critical activity.
Switching sonrası PMS/DP mimic, load sha: After switching, cross-check the PMS and DP mimics, the load sharing, the consequence analysis and the alarm status.
Protection ayarındaki seçicilik hatası t: A selectivity error in the protection settings can turn into a blackout of the whole plant.
DP bilgisayarları, operator station, PRS: Verify that the DP computers, operator stations, PRS and sensors have uninterrupted and independent control power supplies.
Her UPS'nin beslediği controller, consol: Verify from the distribution drawing which controllers, consoles, PRS, gyros, MRUs and network equipment each UPS supplies.
Normal, bypass ve alternate supply konum: Check the normal, bypass and alternate supply positions and the charger, inverter and battery alarms.
Battery autonomy/capacity testini planlı: Carry out the battery autonomy and capacity test using the planned procedure and trend any weak cells.
Bir UPS kaybının diğer redundant group'u: Check against the FMEA that the loss of one UPS does not affect the other redundancy group or a common network switch.
Bypass sonrası sistemin normal yedekli k: After a bypass, have two people verify that the system has returned to its normal redundant configuration.
UPS thrusterları beslemez; control power: The UPS does not supply the thrusters; propulsion power can be lost while control power is still available.
Ortak maintenance bypass iki UPS'yi tek: A common maintenance bypass can turn two UPS into a single point of failure.
Her propulsion unit'in komut, pitch/rpm/: Before a DP task, the command chain, pitch, rpm and azimuth feedback, lubrication, cooling and local control of each propulsion unit are proved.
Hydraulic oil, lube oil, seal, cooling,: Check the hydraulic oil, lube oil, seal, cooling, steering and motor and drive parameters against the manufacturer's limits.
Bridge ile düşük thrustta ahead/astern v: With the bridge, prove the ahead and astern or port and starboard commands at low thrust.
Command ile actual pitch, rpm ve azimuth: Compare the commanded and actual pitch, rpm and azimuth feedback; record the delay and the deadband.
Local/remote, emergency stop, pitch-to-z: Return the local/remote, emergency stop, pitch-to-zero and drive protection functions from test to their operating positions.
Derating veya unavailable thruster'ı DP: Define a derated or unavailable thruster correctly in the DP model and update the capability and consequence analysis.
Yanlış azimuth veya pitch feedback'i DP': Wrong azimuth or pitch feedback can make the DP produce force in the wrong direction.
Online görünen ancak local moda alınmış: A thruster that appears online but has been put into local mode is a hidden failure.
Thruster wash, hull/other-thruster etkil: The expected loss of net thrust from thruster wash, interaction with the hull and other thrusters, and mechanically forbidden angles is correctly reflected in the control system.
Azimuth forbidden sector, tunnel-thruste: Verify the azimuth forbidden sectors, the tunnel-thruster speed limit and the thruster-to-thruster interaction map from the manufacturer's data.
Taut wire, diver, ROV, umbilical veya ri: Check the thrust inhibits and limits defined for the taut wire, divers, ROV, umbilicals or riser.
Thruster bias ve power priority ayarları: Confirm that the thruster bias and power priority settings suit the task and the capacity of the redundancy groups.
DP'nin demanded ve delivered thrust değe: Trend the DP's demanded and delivered thrust; investigate a low response despite a high command.
Ayar değişikliğini MOC ve Master/DPO/Chi: Do not change settings without MOC and the approval of the Master, the DPO and the Chief Engineer.
Thruster wash dalgıç, ROV ve hafif seabe: Thruster wash is a direct danger to divers, the ROV and light seabed equipment.
DP plant'in ortak yardımcı sistem arızas: The DP plant is prevented from losing more than one generator or thruster through a failure in a common auxiliary system.
Sea-water ve fresh-water cooling hatları: Line up the sea water and fresh water cooling lines in line with the redundancy group boundaries.
Duty/standby pump auto-start, low pressu: Test the duty and standby pump auto-start and the low pressure, high temperature and strainer differential pressure alarms.
Fuel service/day tank, transfer, quick-c: Compare the dependencies on the fuel service and day tanks, transfer, quick-closing valves and purifiers with the FMEA.
Starting air receiver, compressor ve cro: Verify that the starting air receivers, compressors and cross-connection settings remain adequate after a single failure.
Ventilation, fire damper ve machinery-sp: Check the effect of the ventilation, fire dampers and machinery space flooding boundaries on the redundancy groups.
Online güç, propulsion veya kontrol sist: Before any work on an online power, propulsion or control system, its effect on the DP capability is assessed jointly.
İş kapsamını, izole edilecek ekipmanı ve: Use the FMEA and CAMO to define the scope of the work, the equipment to be isolated and the failure effect.
DPO, Chief Engineer ve görev sorumlusuyl: Agree the ASOG status and a suitable work window with the DPO, the Chief Engineer and the person in charge of the task.
PTW/LOTO, test ve geri dönüş planını haz: Prepare the PTW/LOTO, the test and the return-to-service plan; do not put online equipment into local or stop without the bridge's permission.
İş sırasında yeni alarm veya konfigürasy: During the work, report any new alarm or change of configuration to DP control at once.
İş bitiminde fonksiyon testi yap, tüm by: When the work is finished, carry out a function test, remove all bypasses and isolations and verify the consequence analysis.
Tek bir local-control seçimi ASOG'u Yell: A single selection of local control can turn the ASOG to Yellow or Red.
İlk alarm ile sonraki zincir ayrıştırıla: By separating the first alarm from the chain that follows, the technical cause is identified before a drive-off, drift-off or blackout develops.
DP, PMS, IAS/VMS ve switchboard alarm sa: Compare the DP, PMS, IAS/VMS and switchboard alarm times against the same time source.
İlk alarm, breaker hareketi, generator/t: Put the first alarm, breaker operations, generator and thruster trips and control mode changes into a sequence of events.
Frekans, voltaj, kW/kVAr, thrust feedbac: Examine the frequency, voltage, kW/kVAr, thrust feedback, cooling and network trends.
Failure mode'u FMEA ve IMCA M247 compone: Match the failure mode to the FMEA and the IMCA M247 component list; investigate the possibility of a common cause.
Geçici reset yerine güvenli konfigürasyo: Instead of a temporary reset, decide on a safe configuration, the ASOG status and permanent corrective action.
Alarm selinde son alarmı neden sanmak ya: In an alarm flood, taking the last alarm for the cause leads to the wrong response.
Power plant çökmesi önlenir; kısmi veya: Collapse of the power plant is prevented; after a partial or total blackout, propulsion is restored in a controlled sequence.
Reverse power, overload, under-frequency: Verify the test status of the reverse power, overload, under-frequency load shedding and preferential trip settings.
Blackout recovery sırasını emergency gen: Practise the vessel-specific blackout recovery sequence: emergency generator, essential auxiliaries, DG start, bus energisation and thruster connection.
Kısmi blackout'ta sağlam redundant group: In a partial blackout, protect the healthy redundancy group; do not close the tie before isolating the faulty section.
Her geri bağlantıda frekans/voltaj stabi: At each reconnection, check the frequency and voltage stability and the available power.
DPO ile hangi thrusterın önce devreye al: Coordinate with the DPO which thruster is brought in first, according to the escape and drift directions.
Recovery drill sonucunu FMEA, procedure: Feed the results of the recovery drill back into the FMEA, the procedures and the training plan.
Emergency generator DP thruster yükünü t: The emergency generator may not be designed to carry the DP thruster load.
Failure detection, alarm, isolation ve k: Failure detection, alarms, isolation and the performance of the remaining system are verified by controlled tests.
Test programını FMEA failure mode, bekle: Match the test programme to the FMEA failure modes, the expected alarms and effects and the acceptance criteria.
Simülasyon veya canlı trip yöntemini ris: Choose between simulation and a live trip by risk assessment; put the vessel's safety barriers in place.
Generator, breaker, thruster, UPS, netwo: In the generator, breaker, thruster, UPS, network and auxiliary failure tests, compare the actual result with the expected one.
Beklenmeyen etkiyi hemen limitation/defe: Report any unexpected effect at once as a limitation or defect and reflect it in the CAMO and ASOG.
Close-out sonrası tekrar testini kanıtla: After close-out, prove it with a repeat test; update the drawings, software version and FMEA revision.
Donanım, yazılım, parametre ve network d: Hardware, software, parameter and network changes are prevented from compromising redundancy and the failure modes.
Değişikliğin kapsamını; etkilenen contro: Define the scope of the change, with the controllers, I/O, network, protection, HMI, PRS and sensors affected.
FMEA, drawings, spare image/backup ve cy: Assess the effect on the FMEA, drawings, spare images and back-ups, and cyber security within the MOC.
Class, maker ve şirket onaylarını; FAT/S: Arrange the class, manufacturer and company approvals and prepare the FAT/SAT and the rollback plan.
Uygulama sonrası alarm, controller switc: After the change, test the alarms, controller switchover, PRS and sensor inputs, thruster commands and consequence analysis.
Version, parameter, test sonucu ve değiş: Document the version, parameters, test results and any changed operating limits, and give the team familiarisation.
Aynı yazılımın tüm redundant controllerl: Loading the same software onto all redundant controllers at the same time can create a common-mode risk.
Kritik DP bileşenlerinin talep anında ça: To make sure critical DP components work when they are needed, the maintenance plan is managed using failure modes and condition data.
FMEA ile critical equipment list'i PMS g: Match the FMEA and the critical equipment list to the PMS tasks and the spare parts list.
Generator, thruster, breaker, UPS batter: Keep track of the maintenance and test intervals for generators, thrusters, breakers, UPS batteries, cooling pumps, the network and sensors.
Vibration, oil analysis, insulation, the: Trend vibration, oil analysis, insulation, thermography, battery capacity and alarm history.
Tekrarlayan defect ve overdue maintenanc: Report to the Master and the DPO the effect of recurring defects and overdue maintenance on redundancy and the ASOG.
Bakım sonrası return-to-service testini: After maintenance, complete the return-to-service test and an independent verification.
Aynı redundant gruplarda eşzamanlı bakım: Simultaneous maintenance in the same redundancy groups can reduce the DP class.
DP, joystick ve autopilot komutlarını it: The engine department verifies the redundancy and coverage of the TCS, which passes DP, joystick and autopilot commands to the thrusters and propellers, and its back-up control path.
TCS'in üç kontrol bilgisayarı ve yedekli: Confirm that the TCS runs on three control computers and a redundant communication network, and that losing one computer does not lose propulsion control.
Sistemin kontrol ettiği itici ve pervane: List the types of thrusters and propellers the system controls, including tunnel thrusters, Voith, azimuth pods, retractable thrusters and waterjets.
TCS'in motor markasından bağımsız çalışt: Verify from the commissioning records that the TCS works independently of the engine make, but that its interface parameters are set for each unit.
Backup thruster kontrolü ve bağımsız joy: Check that the back-up thruster control and the independent joystick path are separate from the main DP/TCS path and are tested regularly.
Autopilot ve joystick entegrasyonunda ko: Compare with the FMEA how command priority and transfer of control are resolved where the autopilot and joystick are integrated.
Yedek kontrol yolu düzenli test edilmezs: If the back-up control path is not tested regularly, a fault in it shows up only when the main path is lost.
Sevk cihazı tipine göre tepki süresi ve: The response time and derating differ with the type of propulsion unit; one general setting does not suit every unit.
Dağıtık IO üniteleri, yedekli çift ağ ve: Verify that the distributed IO units, the redundant dual network and the uninterruptible control power supplies are segregated so as to prevent a failure from spreading.
DP gemileri için tasarlanmış stand-alone: Verify on site that the stand-alone IO units designed for DP vessels are installed close to the thrusters, reference systems and sensors, reducing the cabling.
Her IO ünitesinin hangi redundant gruba: Find from the single-line diagram which redundancy group each IO unit belongs to and its power supply.
Yedekli çift ağın iki kolunun fiziksel o: Check that the two branches of the redundant dual network follow physically separate routes and would not both be lost in a single fire or flooding.
DP bilgisayarları, operatör istasyonları: Verify from the test records that the UPS supplies to the DP computers, operator stations, PRS and sensors are independent, and check the battery autonomy.
Ağ switch, IP ve konfigürasyon değişikli: Keep changes to network switches, IP addresses and configuration under controlled management of change.
Kablolamanın azalması aynı IO ünitesine: Less cabling means more equipment concentrated on the same IO unit; the effect of losing each unit must be assessed one by one.
Ağ kollarının aynı kablo kanalından geçm: If the network branches run through the same cable tray, dual network redundancy exists only on paper.
UPS batarya kapasitesi test edilmeden be: The stated autonomy cannot be relied on unless the UPS battery capacity has been tested.
Mevcut Bridge Mate kurulumunun moderniza: Modernising an existing Bridge Mate installation or upgrading it to a higher DP class is planned without breaking the redundancy and the certification chain.
Midlife upgrade kapsamını belirle: kontr: Define the scope of the midlife upgrade: assess whether the existing IO cabinets and cabling can be kept while the control computers, operator stations, network switches and software are replaced.
Sınıf yükseltmesinde aynı donanım modüll: Note that a class upgrade is done by adding more of the same hardware modules: from JX to DP 0, from DP 0 to a higher class, from DP 1 to DP 2.
DP 1 → DP 2 geçişinde üç kontrol bilgisa: For an upgrade from DP 1 to DP 2, plan for three control computers, an additional operator station, separate IO units for each item of equipment and a redundant dual network.
DP 3 hedefleniyorsa yangına dayanıklı ay: If DP 3 is the aim, design early the layout changes for a separate fire-resistant compartment, a third operator station and a third IO set.
Yükseltme sonrası FMEA revizyonu, provin: Plan the FMEA revision, proving trials and class survey for after the upgrade before the work ends; in the meantime, enter the valid DP class and restrictions in the ASOG.
Yükseltme sırasında gemi beyan edilen DP: During an upgrade the vessel may not meet its declared DP class; acceptance of work must be restricted during this period.

Denetimde bulunan her eksiklik, standart: Every deficiency found during an inspection is recorded with a standard code and given an action to rectify it. Some deficiencies are rectified on the spot (code 10), some are deferred to be rectified at the next port (code 15) or within a set time (code 16, for example 14 days), and some must be rectified before departure (code 17); notifications to the flag State or the classification society are recorded with separate codes (code 50/70). The most severe action is detention (code 30): the ship may not leave port until the serious deficiencies have been rectified and it is safe. Deficiencies are grouped into 17 main categories (certificates, structural safety, fire safety, life-saving appliances, safety of navigation, MARPOL, ISM, ISPS, MLC, BWM and others) with hundreds of sub-codes. This standardisation means that inspectors in every port in the world speak the same language and that results are shared consistently in the regional databases (THETIS, APCIS).

OCIMF'in SIRE programı 2 Eylül 2024'te k: On 2 September 2024 OCIMF's SIRE programme was thoroughly overhauled and became SIRE 2.0. The old fixed question list (VIQ7) was replaced by a tablet-based set of questions compiled for each ship according to its type and operation (the Compiled VIQ). The inspection covers dozens of areas, from certification and crew management to navigation, cargo and ballast operations and the engine room, and measures the human factor (the crew's knowledge and behaviour) far more than before. The HVPQ (vessel particulars questionnaire) and the company-level TMSA self-assessment complete the framework.
Vetting denetiminin çıktısı, üye şirketl: The output of a vetting inspection is a report shared with the member companies, so every potential charterer can see the negative observations from a single inspection. Observations that are not closed stop the ship winning new business, poor performance raises insurance premiums and terminals may refuse the ship. A drop in the company's TMSA assessment spreads the problem from one ship to the whole fleet. That is why ships carry out a thorough internal inspection before vetting (pre-vetting), keep their documentation faultless and, above all, prepare key personnel (the Master and the Chief Engineer) for questions in the SIRE 2.0 format. In modern tanker operation, vetting is a commercial gateway as decisive as regulatory compliance.
Eski SIRE formatı büyük ölçüde ekipman v: The old SIRE format focused largely on equipment and documentation: static checks such as whether a fire pump works or a certificate is valid. SIRE 2.0 keeps this but shifts the weight clearly to the human factor; responses are assessed under human, process and hardware, and through these questions the inspector tries to understand why the crew carry out a procedure in a particular way, how they assess a risk and how they make decisions under pressure. The change reflects a lesson the industry has drawn from accident statistics: most marine casualties are caused not by equipment failure but by the human factor (fatigue, breakdowns in communication, misunderstood procedures, hierarchical pressure). So even a technically faultless ship can receive negative observations under SIRE 2.0 if the crew's decision-making culture is weak. This shows that vetting has moved on from asking 'is the equipment there?' to asking 'will this team make the right decision in a crisis?', in line with the human-centred approach of modern safety management that the ISM Code also stresses.
RightShip 2001'de BHP Billiton, Rio Tint: RightShip was set up in 2001 by BHP Billiton, Rio Tinto and Cargill to assess the safety of bulk carriers. Initially focused on safety, the platform began assessing environmental performance as well when it added the GHG Rating in 2012. Today it is the standard tool for commercial acceptance of bulk carriers, general cargo ships and container ships. In February 2021 the Safety Score replaced the old risk rating.

RightShip'in gerçek gücü, puanın kendisi: RightShip's real power lies not in the score itself but in how deeply it is built into the chartering processes of major cargo owners. Large grain and ore traders, mining companies and oil companies set a minimum Safety Score in their corporate policies and build that threshold into their chartering systems as a hard filter. The result is mechanical: a ship below the threshold cannot even be offered to that company's broker, because the system screens it out automatically. This is a different kind of exclusion from a PSC detention; the ship may not have broken any rule, but its commercial access has been closed by a software threshold. This makes RightShip less a regulator than an invisible front door to the chartering pool, and forces owners to manage risk knowing that a PSC detention or a casualty record will mark the score for a long time.

It is mandatory for ships of 500 GT and over on international voyages and is issued by the flag State or an authorised classification society once compliance in the 16 MLC inspection areas has been verified. It is valid for 5 years, with an intermediate inspection midway through.
Sertifikanın kapsadığı 16 alan (2014 değ: The 16 areas the certificate covers (including the two financial security areas added by the 2014 amendments) take in almost every part of a seafarer's life on board: minimum age, medical certification, qualifications, the employment agreement (SEA), recruitment services, hours of work and rest, manning, accommodation, recreational facilities, food, health and safety, medical care, complaint procedures, payment of wages, and financial security for repatriation and for shipowners' liability. How each area is met is documented in the DMLC, an integral part of the certificate: Part I sets out the flag State's national requirements and Part II shows how the company complies with them. Hours of rest (at least 10 in any 24 hours and at least 77 in any 7 days) follow the same rules as STCW and are carefully recorded.

DMLC (Declaration of Maritime Labour Com: The DMLC (Declaration of Maritime Labour Compliance) is the distinctive, practical heart of the MLC 2006 certification system. The MLC Certificate 'confirms' compliance but does not say how it is achieved; the DMLC fills that gap and is kept on board as an integral part of the certificate. It has two parts: Part I is drawn up by the flag State and sets out what national law requires in the 16 MLC areas (with any substantially equivalent national provisions); Part II is drawn up by the company and sets out how it actually meets those requirements in each area. The declaration thus answers both 'what does the rule say?' and 'how do we apply it?' in one document.
DMLC, PSC denetiminde en çok incelenen b: The DMLC is one of the documents most closely examined at a PSC inspection, because it is a ready-made checklist for the inspector: every procedure written in Part II is compared with what is actually done on board. The most critical risk is a mismatch between the declaration and reality; for example, if Part II says records of hours of work are kept but the records are incomplete, that is a serious non-compliance and a possible ground for detention. So Part II must be updated when the company's personnel policy or procedures change, changes to the national requirements in Part I must be followed, and concrete evidence of compliance (records, agreements, certificates) must be kept ready on board for each of the 16 areas. If the MLC Certificate becomes invalid, so does the DMLC.
DMLC, MLC'nin 16 denetim alanını hem ulu: The DMLC documents the 16 MLC inspection areas at the level of both the national requirements and the company's practice. These areas cover almost every part of a seafarer's life on board: minimum age, medical certification, qualifications of seafarers, the employment agreement (SEA), recruitment services, hours of work and rest, manning levels, accommodation, recreational facilities, food and catering, health and safety, medical care, on-board complaint procedures, payment of wages, and financial security for repatriation and for shipowners' liability. Part I explains what the flag State requires in each area (and any substantially equivalent national provisions); Part II sets out the company's plan showing how it actually meets those requirements. The DMLC thus answers 'what does the rule say?' and 'how do we apply it?' in one document and serves as a ready-made checklist for the inspector.
DMLC denetiminin en kritik yönü, Part II: The most critical part of a DMLC inspection is comparing every procedure written in Part II with what is actually done on board. The most serious risk is a mismatch between the declaration and reality: for example, if Part II says records of hours of work are kept but the records are incomplete, or a complaint procedure is defined but the crew do not know about it, that is a major non-compliance and a possible ground for detention. So Part II must be updated and notified to the flag State or RO when the company's personnel policy or procedures change; changes to the national requirements in Part I must be followed; and concrete evidence of compliance (records, agreements, certificates) must be kept ready on board for each of the 16 areas. The DMLC only has meaning together with the MLC Certificate; if the certificate becomes invalid, so does the DMLC, and the ship cannot make international voyages.

ISGOTT (International Safety Guide for O: ISGOTT (International Safety Guide for Oil Tankers and Terminals) is published jointly by OCIMF (Oil Companies International Marine Forum), ICS (International Chamber of Shipping) and IAPH (International Association of Ports and Harbors). It originated in the 1970s when the Tanker Safety Guide and terminal safety guides were combined. It is not a mandatory IMO convention but an industry guide accepted in practice as the global standard; it turns regulations such as SOLAS, MARPOL and the FSS Code into practical operations. The latest edition is the 6th, published in 2020 (ISGOTT 6); it stands out for its approach to the human factor, ship/shore communication and the updated Ship/Shore Safety Checklist (SSSCL).
ISGOTT, zorunlu bir sözleşme değil, ama: ISGOTT is not a mandatory convention, but it is the 'gold standard' that the oil tanker and terminal world is expected to follow in practice. Regulations such as SOLAS, MARPOL and the FSS Code say what must be done; ISGOTT explains step by step how to do it safely on site. The hazards on tankers are exceptionally high: the cargo is flammable, toxic and harmful to the environment, much of the operation is a shared responsibility of the ship and the shore (or another ship), and a single mistake can turn into a disaster. ISGOTT standardises this shared responsibility; because OCIMF, ICS and IAPH publish it together, the ship and the terminal speak the same language. That is why vetting inspections look for ISGOTT practices as the de facto reference.

1982'de kurulan Paris MoU, liman devleti: Established in 1982, the Paris MoU is the world's first and most comprehensive memorandum of understanding coordinating port State control at regional level. It succeeded the Hague Memorandum (1978). With 28 participating maritime Administrations (the European Union coastal States plus Canada, Iceland, Montenegro, Norway and the UK; the membership of the Russian Federation has been suspended since 20 May 2022), it covers some of the world's busiest sea areas. The New Inspection Regime (NIR), introduced in 2011, set up a risk-based targeting system. About 18,000 inspections are carried out each year.

It works closely with the Paris MoU and runs joint CIC campaigns.

Paris MoU, liman devleti kontrolünün böl: The Paris MoU is the memorandum of understanding that invented regional coordination of port State control and became a model for the world. One State's inspections cover only its own ports, but ships move around a region. The basic idea of the Paris MoU is that the member States share their inspection results in a common database (THETIS) and divide the inspection workload between them. So when a ship is inspected in one member's port, every member can see the result, unnecessary repeat inspections are avoided and substandard ships can be followed across the region. With 28 participating Administrations, it covers one of the world's busiest areas of sea traffic.
Tokyo MoU, Asya-Pasifik bölgesindeki 22: The Tokyo MoU coordinates port State control by 22 member Authorities in the Asia-Pacific region and covers the waters with the world's heaviest container and dry cargo traffic. It is the largest PSC region in the world by annual number of inspections, carrying out tens of thousands every year. It shares the same basic philosophy as the Paris MoU: sharing inspection results through a common database (APCIS), dividing the inspection workload between members and tracking substandard ships across the region. The two MoUs work closely together and often run joint CIC campaigns.

Black Sea MoU, Karadeniz'e kıyısı olan a: The Black Sea MoU coordinates port State control in the six countries with a Black Sea coast (Bulgaria, Georgia, Romania, Russia, Türkiye, Ukraine). The region has an interesting structural feature: Bulgaria and Romania, as EU members, are also members of the Paris MoU, while Türkiye belongs to both the Black Sea and the Mediterranean MoUs. These overlapping memberships keep Black Sea inspections closely in line with Paris MoU standards. Inspection data are shared through the regional BSIS system and are visible to all members.
Karadeniz'e giriş ve çıkış, dünyanın en: Entry to and exit from the Black Sea is through the Turkish Straits (the Istanbul and Çanakkale Straits), one of the most difficult passages in the world; it is a corridor of heavy traffic, sharp turns and strong currents. The transit requires compliance with the reporting requirements and traffic arrangements of the Turkish Straits Vessel Traffic Service (VTS); it is a place where COLREG and safe navigation practice are put to the test. From a PSC point of view, before entering Black Sea ports ships should review the current CIC subjects with the crew, share the evidence of closed findings with the flag State and the classification society, and take account of their own records in the BSIS system, where inspection data are shared. The geopolitical situation in the region can at times affect navigation and access to ports, adding a further variable to route planning.
Küçük bir bloğun veri paylaşım değeri: B: The value of data sharing in a small bloc: BSIS
Black Sea MoU, yalnızca altı üye devletl: With only six member States, the Black Sea MoU is a small bloc compared with the Paris or Tokyo MoU; but its small size does not reduce the value of data sharing – on the contrary, it makes it more manageable and focused. Inspection results, deficiencies and detention records shared through BSIS prevent a great deal of duplication even in a region with a limited number of ports: when a ship is inspected in Constanța and a deficiency is found, that information is also visible to the next inspector in Odesa or Novorossiysk, who can then concentrate on following up what was found before rather than inspecting the ship again unnecessarily. The small membership also speeds up coordination: choosing CIC subjects and joint decisions pass through fewer bureaucratic layers than in MoUs with many members. The dual membership of Bulgaria and Romania in the Paris MoU keeps BSIS indirectly in line with THETIS, so that even a small regional system contributes to the data integrity of the wider European PSC network.

Indian Ocean MoU, Hint Okyanusu ve çevre: The Indian Ocean MoU coordinates port State control by nearly 20 member States in and around the Indian Ocean; its members are spread over a vast area, from Australia to India and from South Africa to Iran and the coasts of East Africa. The region carries the busiest trade routes between Suez and the Strait of Malacca and a critical share of the world's oil and container traffic. The MoU shares inspection data through the regional IOMIS system and identifies priority ships by risk-based targeting.
1997'de kurulan Mediterranean MoU, Akden: Established in 1997, the Mediterranean MoU coordinates the PSC inspections of countries with a Mediterranean coast. Its member States include North African countries (Algeria, Egypt, Morocco, Tunisia), Eastern Mediterranean countries (Israel, Lebanon, Türkiye), Malta and Cyprus. It works closely with the Paris MoU, and its Mediterranean EU members (Malta, Cyprus) are also members of the Paris MoU.
